cards.title: Gelatinous Shot
cards.rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots. Something's floating in it. A tooth? Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6, no hands.
It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands.
You eat your way out. Give 3.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

cards.title: Rats in a Coat
cards.rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Their ID is better than yours. Drink 6.
Their ID is better than yours. Drink 3.
Bounced. Give 3 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.
Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.

cards.title: Mold Elemental
cards.rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 6 and cough on both neighbors.
You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor.
Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3.
Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

cards.title: Drunk Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6 and hug your right neighbor.
He wins both. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor.
He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2.
Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Barback
cards.rules: He's been restocking limes since 1974. Ask him nicely for a fresh one.

strike.even: He hands you a dry one. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: He finds a perfect one. Give 3, with a lime.
strike.disadvantage: He throws one at your eye. Drink 3.

cards.title: Possessed Mop
cards.rules: The mop is moving on its own and it's coming for your shoes.

strike.even: It mops your feet. Drink 2 and lift them.
strike.advantage: You snap the handle. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It mops your face. Drink 3.

cards.title: Keg Spider
cards.rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Squished. Give 3.
Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 6.

cards.title: Tab Goblin
cards.rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8.
It collects. Drink 4.
You stiff it. Give 3 to whoever owes you money.
Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

cards.title: Goblin Shaman
cards.rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6.
The chant works. Drink 3.
You blow out the sage. Give 3 to whoever smells most like it.
Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6 to whoever smells most like it.

jinx.name: Goblin Tongue
jinx.rule: The jinxed player speaks of themself in the third person. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Cask Bat
cards.rules: A bat lives in the empty cask and it hates the lights.

strike.even: It flaps past your ear. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: You shoo it into a bucket. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It gets tangled in your hair. Drink 3.

cards.title: Clipboard Troll
cards.rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

cards.title: The Riddling Tap
cards.rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

cards.title: The Stuck Door
cards.rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

cards.title: Keg Stand-Off
cards.rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor. You blink or laugh first: drink 3.

cards.title: Sticky Floor
cards.rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You peel free. Give 2.
Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

cards.title: Tripwire
cards.rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4.
You eat the stairs. Drink 2.
You hop it. Give 2 to the clumsiest player here.
Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to the clumsiest player here.

cards.title: Rolling Kegs
cards.rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6, lying down if you can.
Flattened. Drink 3, lying down if you can.
You dive clear. Give 2 to whoever didn't flinch.
Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4 to whoever didn't flinch.

cards.title: Loose Tap Handles
cards.rules: A rack of novelty tap handles is right above your head. It's swaying.

strike.even: A foam one bonks you. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: You dodge, then catch the shark. Give 2.
strike.disadvantage: A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 3.

jinx.name: Thumb Master
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player puts a thumb on the table, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Lost Bridesmaids
cards.rules: Two lost bridesmaids have decided you're the groom. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! First dance. Drink 4, then sway with your right neighbor.
First dance. Drink 2, then sway with your right neighbor.
You point them upstairs. Give 2.
Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

cards.title: The Rat Pack
cards.rules: Three rats in fedoras, singing Sinatra, and they want your stool. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They do it their way. Drink 4.
They do it their way. Drink 2.
You heckle them offstage. Give 2.
Natural 20! You heckle them offstage. Give 4.

cards.title: Fryer Oil Ooze
cards.rules: Twenty years of fryer oil got up and walked. It smells like Tuesday.

strike.advantage: You salt it with a spell and it shrivels. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It hugs you. Drink 3, then wipe your hands on your jeans.

cards.title: Barback Poltergeist
cards.rules: An invisible barback keeps stacking empty glasses on your head. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: The tower falls. Drink 3.
You tip him a coin. Stack two empty glasses on someone's head, then give 3.

dice.doubles: He stacks glasses on everyone else instead. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Cobweb Bartender
cards.rules: A bartender made of cobwebs slides you something cloudy.

strike.advantage: You bless the glass and the cobwebs fall away. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It's mostly spider. Drink 3 and shiver.

cards.title: The Low Beam
cards.rules: Your right neighbor holds out an arm as the beam. Limbo under it. Touch it: drink 3.

cards.title: Loose Floorboard
cards.rules: One board in the cellar floor is not like the others. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It springs up and smacks you. Drink 4.
It springs up and smacks you. Drink 2.
You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 2.
Natural 20! You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 4.

cards.title: The Stag Party
cards.rules: Eight men in matching shirts, one in a veil, all looking for a ninth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Recruited. Drink 4, then give a best-man toast.
Recruited. Drink 2, then give a best-man toast.
You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 2.
Natural 20! You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 4.

cards.title: Grease Trap Horror
cards.rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8, then wash your hands in shame.
It slurps you in. Drink 4, then wash your hands in shame.
You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 4.
Natural 20! You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 8.

cards.title: The Health Inspector
cards.rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8 and name three things wrong with this room.
Violation. Drink 4 and name three things wrong with this room.
You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

cards.title: Keg Mimic Queen
cards.rules: Every keg in the rack opens one eye. The big one in the middle opens two. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole rack bites. Drink 8.
The whole rack bites. Drink 4.
You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

spoils.name: Queen's Tap
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Royal Jelly Shot
spoils.rules: +1 to monster d20s. Comes with a Healing Draught.

cards.title: The Exterminator
cards.rules: He's here for the rats, and he's decided you count. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sprayed. Drink 8, holding your breath.
Sprayed. Drink 4, holding your breath.
You hide him in an empty keg. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hide him in an empty keg. Give 8.

cards.title: Keg Golem
cards.rules: It's 800 pounds of lager and it's been tapped. Everyone drinks 1, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8.
It sits on you. Drink 4.
You pull its plug. Give 5.
Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Keg Plug
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Comes with a Coaster Shield.

phases.rules: It gets back up, foaming. Chug race with your left neighbor, playing the Golem. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Rat King
cards.rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court by the drain. Kiss the ring, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink.
The court finds you guilty. Drink 4.
You dethrone him. Give 5.
Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

jinx.name: Royal Decree
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player Your Majesty. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: The court is in session. Plead your case to the table for 20 seconds; they vote. Guilty: drink 3.

cards.title: The Landlord
cards.rules: He wants three months' rent and he's taking it out of your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink.
Late fee. Drink 4.
You find a code violation. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

phases.rules: He's back with a clipboard for the inspection. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He finds the mold. Drink 4.
He finds nothing. Give 4.

dice.doubles: You find his own code violation. Give 6.

jinx.name: Rent Due
jinx.rule: The jinxed player asks the table's permission before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Big Cheese
cards.rules: A rat the size of a fridge, wearing a cheese wheel as armor. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on your snacks. Drink 8.
It sits on your snacks. Drink 4.
You eat through the armor. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the armor and the rat. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It rolls at you, cheese first. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Flattened. Drink 4.
Cheese in your hair. Drink 3.
You dodge. Give 3.
You take a bite out of it. Give 3.
It rolls into the wall. Give 4.
You grate it. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Pipe Organ
cards.rules: Every pipe in the cellar is playing one chord, and it's coming from a face. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join the chord. Hum for 10 seconds, then drink 8.
The chord hits you in the teeth. Drink 4.
You find the off switch. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find the off switch. Give 10.

spoils.name: Pipe Whistle
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

phases.rules: It plays your song. Hum any song; the table has 15 seconds to name it. Nobody does: drink 3.

jinx.name: Organ Voice
jinx.rule: The jinxed player sings everything they say. Speaks normally: drink 1.

cards.title: Boxed Wine Golem
cards.rules: A golem made of boxed wine, slapping its own bag. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It slaps you with the bag. Drink 6, and slap the table twice.
It slaps you with the bag. Drink 3, and slap the table twice.
You pop the spout. Give 3.
Natural 20! You drink the bag dry. Give 6.

cards.title: Cork Imp
cards.rules: A tiny imp popping corks at eye level and laughing about it. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Right in the eye. Drink 3 with one eye shut.
Right in the drink. Drink 3.
You duck. Give 2.
You cork him. Give 3.
You cork him and shake him. Give 3.
You pop one back at him. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Zombie Sommelier
cards.rules: Brains? No. He wants to describe the finish. It takes eleven minutes.

strike.advantage: You talk over him until he leaves. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Notes of oak. Drink 3 and describe the finish of yours.

cards.title: Wine Mom Banshee
cards.rules: She screams that it's five o'clock somewhere, and she means here. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She tells you about her divorce. All of it. Drink 6.
It's five o'clock. Drink 3.
You take her glass away. Give 3 to the biggest wine mom here.
Natural 20! You take her glass away. Give 6 to the biggest wine mom here.

cards.title: Rosé Slime
cards.rules: Pink, sticky, and it says it's not like other slimes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 6.
It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 3.
You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 2.
Natural 20! You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 4.

cards.title: Ghost in the Decanter
cards.rules: It's been breathing for a hundred years. So has the wine. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It breathes on you. Drink 3 and say 'notes of ghost'.
You jam the stopper in. Give 3 to the snobbiest drinker here.

dice.doubles: You decant it into someone else's glass. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Spooked
jinx.rule: Nobody may look the jinxed player in the eye. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: Barrel Mimic
cards.rules: Barrel 14 has teeth. Barrel 15 looks nervous.

strike.advantage: You punch it shut. Give 3 to the most nervous player.
strike.disadvantage: Barrel 14 wins. Drink 3.

cards.title: Corkscrew Crab
cards.rules: A crab with corkscrews for claws, opening anything. Including you.

strike.advantage: You flip it on its back. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Uncorked. Drink 3 and walk sideways to your seat.

cards.title: Sangria Sprite
cards.rules: A sprite made of fruit chunks and bad decisions throws an orange slice at you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fruit to the face. Drink 6.
Fruit to the face. Drink 3.
You eat the sprite. It was mostly brandy. Give 3.
Natural 20! You eat the sprite. It was mostly brandy. Give 6.

cards.title: Vinegar Vampire
cards.rules: A vampire who only drinks from bottles that turned. He's been at yours. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's right, it turned. Drink 6, make the face.
He's right, it turned. Drink 3, make the face.
You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 3.
Natural 20! You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 6.

jinx.name: Sour Face
jinx.rule: The jinxed player pulls a sour face before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Blind Tasting
cards.rules: Eyes shut. Your left neighbor hands you a drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Flamingo
cards.rules: Stand on one leg with your eyes shut for 10 seconds. Wobble or peek: drink 3.

cards.title: Swirl, Sniff, Lie
cards.rules: Review your drink like a sommelier for 15 seconds. Crack a smile: drink 3.

cards.title: The Toast
cards.rules: Toast your right neighbor, sincerely, for 20 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

cards.title: Falling Rack
cards.rules: The wine rack tips, one bottle at a time, like dominoes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Domino'd. Drink 6.
Domino'd. Drink 3.
You catch the last one. Give 2, and hand someone your 'bottle'.
Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4, and hand someone your 'bottle'.

cards.title: Merlot Stairs
cards.rules: The stairs are slick with spilled merlot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down on your ass, in red. Drink 4 standing up.
Down on your ass, in red. Drink 2 standing up.
Not a drop on you. Give 2.
Natural 20! Not a drop on you. Give 4.

cards.title: Sulfite Cloud
cards.rules: A cracked cask puffs out a cloud of sulfites. Instant headache.

strike.advantage: You blow it away with a word. Give 2.
strike.disadvantage: Migraine. Drink 3 and rub your temples.

cards.title: Cork Mines
cards.rules: The floor is covered in corks. Some of them click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Pop. Drink 4.
Pop. Drink 2.
You tiptoe through. Give 2 to whoever walks loudest.
Natural 20! You tiptoe through. Give 4 to whoever walks loudest.

cards.title: Fruit Fly Swarm
cards.rules: A cloud of fruit flies off the dump bucket, and they brought friends. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4 with a hand over your glass.
In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass.
Swatted. Give 2.
Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

cards.title: The Book Club
cards.rules: Four women with one book none of them read, and a lot of opinions about you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They have notes. Drink 4.
They have notes. Drink 2.
You've read it. They scatter. Give 2.
Natural 20! You've read it. They scatter. Give 4.

cards.title: Cork Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin with a corkscrew for a hand and nothing to open. Then he sees you.

strike.advantage: You hand him a screw-top. He weeps. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: He opens you. Drink 3.

cards.title: Rosé Elemental
cards.rules: A pink spirit that says 'rosé all day' and means it as a threat.

strike.advantage: You banish it with one word: blush. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: All day it is. Drink 3.

cards.title: Tannin Troll
cards.rules: It dries out every mouth in the room. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Your tongue sticks. Drink 3, then say 'tannin' five times fast.
You out-spit it. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It dries itself out. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Palate Test
cards.rules: Your left neighbor names three wines, one made up. Spot the fake. Wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: Sediment Pit
cards.rules: The bottom of the barrel is a pit, and the pit is all dregs. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You wade through. Drink 4, and chew.
You wade through. Drink 2, and chew.
You vault it. Give 2.
Natural 20! You vault it. Give 4.

cards.title: The Gender Reveal
cards.rules: A lost gender reveal party wants you to guess. They have a smoke cannon. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 4.
Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 2.
You leave before the smoke. Give 2.
Natural 20! You leave before the smoke. Give 4.

cards.title: The Wine Snob
cards.rules: He swirls, he sniffs, he says you'd like something approachable. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Approachable. Drink 8, and say it's 'fun'.
Approachable. Drink 4, and say it's 'fun'.
You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 4.
Natural 20! You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 8.

cards.title: Grape Elemental
cards.rules: Two tons of grapes, stomped into rage. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds.
Raisin. Give 4.
Natural 20! Raisin. Give 8.

cards.title: The Cellar Master
cards.rules: He knows every bottle, and you broke one. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes you sweep. Drink 8.
He makes you sweep. Drink 4.
You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 8.

spoils.name: Cellar Master's Keys
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Coaster Shield.

cards.title: The Wine Influencer
cards.rules: Two million followers and a ring light. She needs you in her story. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're the background. Drink 8, and pose.
You're the background. Drink 4, and pose.
You photobomb her. Give 4.
Natural 20! You photobomb her. Give 8.

cards.title: Count Corkula
cards.rules: He does not drink... blood. He drinks pinot. Yours. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He drains your glass. Drink 8.
He drains your glass. Drink 4.
A stake through the cork. Give 5.
Natural 20! Sunlight. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: Fangs out. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing the Count. Blink first: drink 3.

jinx.name: The Count
jinx.rule: The jinxed player counts their sips out loud, with a cackle. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Cask Queen
cards.rules: She sits on a throne of barrels and judges your palate. Curtsy, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off with your glass. Finish your drink.
Your palate is basic. Drink 4.
You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 10.

jinx.name: Curtsy Court
jinx.rule: The jinxed player curtsies before every drink. Forget: drink 1.

spoils.name: Queen's Scepter
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

phases.rules: She demands a toast. Give her one, ten seconds, no ums; the table judges. Fail: drink 3.

cards.title: Château Ghoul
cards.rules: A ghoul in a beret who thinks your wine is beneath you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He sneers you to death. Drink 8.
He sneers you to death. Drink 4.
You hand him a White Claw. He dissolves. Give 5.
Natural 20! He dissolves into a nice rosé. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: He sniffs your glass with contempt. Roll 2d6 to prove your taste.

outcomes.instruction: Corked. Drink 4.
Notes of oak and victory. Give 4.

cards.title: The Grand Sommelier
cards.rules: Ten feet tall, a tastevin on a chain, and he has never been wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He spits your drink back in your glass. Drink 8.
He names your drink, your year and your ex. Drink 4.
He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 5.
Natural 20! He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 10.

phases.rules: Blind tasting: eyes shut, sip a drink the table hands you. Name it wrong: drink 3.

cards.title: The Barrel Room
cards.rules: Two hundred barrels, one of them alive, and they're all rolling. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rolled flat. Drink 8.
Rolled flat. Drink 4.
You find the live one and tap it. Give 5.
Natural 20! You surf a barrel out. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Bung Mallet
spoils.rules: Comes with a Loaded Die and a Healing Draught.

phases.rules: The live barrel charges. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It rolls over you. Drink 4.
It rolls over your foot. Drink 3.
You jump it. Give 3.
You stop it with one hand. Give 3.
It rolls into the others. Give 4.
You ride it out. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Barrel Roll
jinx.rule: The jinxed player says 'barrel roll!' whenever anyone rolls. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: Bachelor Ghosts
cards.rules: The ghosts of a 1998 bachelor party want one more round. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the round. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story.
You're in the round. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story.
You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 4.
Natural 20! You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 8.

cards.title: The Ex Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith with your ex's face reads your old texts aloud, with feeling. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads the drafts. Finish your drink.
Every word lands. Drink 4.
You read theirs back. Give 4 to whoever has the worst ex.
Natural 20! You read theirs back. Give 8 to whoever has the worst ex.

cards.title: Bone Sommelier
cards.rules: A skeleton in a sommelier's chain rates your drink. Out of ten, it's a two. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Shamed. Drink 8.
Shamed. Drink 4.
You pour his on the floor. Rate someone's drink out of ten; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You pour his on the floor. Rate someone's drink out of ten; they drink 8.

cards.title: Leech Swarm
cards.rules: Leeches that drink blood and, apparently, Fireball. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They latch on and won't let go. Drink 6.
They latch on and won't let go. Drink 3.
You salt them. Give 4 to the saltiest player here.
Natural 20! You salt them. Give 8 to the saltiest player here.

jinx.name: Leeched
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player sips, their left neighbor sips too. Neighbor forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Hex Witch
cards.rules: A witch who reads tarot and your browser history. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hexed. Drink 6, and confess your last search.
Hexed. Drink 3, and confess your last search.
You flip her table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You flip her table. Give 8.

jinx.name: Witch's Cackle
jinx.rule: The jinxed player cackles before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Vampire Bro
cards.rules: A vampire in a backwards cap who only drinks from frat boys. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8.
He makes an exception. Drink 4.
Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 3.
Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

cards.title: Crypt Crawler
cards.rules: Something with a hundred legs and one beer gut. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It crawls up your shirt. Drink 4, and shake it out.
You stomp it flat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You stomp it with both feet. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Hungover Mummy
cards.rules: A mummy wrapped in bar napkins, hungover for three thousand years.

strike.advantage: You lay it to rest with a Gatorade. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: It throws up sand on you. Drink 4.

cards.title: Karaoke Banshee
cards.rules: A banshee with a mic and a song list. She's picked yours.

strike.advantage: You duet and she swoons. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Total Eclipse of the Heart. Sing the chorus, then drink 4.

cards.title: The Lich's Accountant
cards.rules: He's doing the Lich's taxes, and you're a deduction. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Audited. Drink 8.
Audited. Drink 4.
You find an error in his math. Give 4, then explain it badly.
Natural 20! You find an error in his math. Give 8, then explain it badly.

jinx.name: Question Master
jinx.rule: Anyone who answers a question from the jinxed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Tomb of Silence
cards.rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Bone Tower
cards.rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

cards.title: Backwards Chant
cards.rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Séance
cards.rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

cards.title: Collapsing Floor
cards.rules: The floor gives way under you.

strike.advantage: You leap to safety. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: You fall a whole floor. Drink 3.

cards.title: Dart Wall
cards.rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darted, in the ass. Drink 6 standing.
Darted, in the ass. Drink 3 standing.
You limbo under them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

cards.title: Fog of Regret
cards.rules: A green fog that smells like the tequila from your 21st. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6.
Flashbacks. Drink 3.
You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst 21st.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst 21st.

jinx.name: Tequila Flashback
jinx.rule: The jinxed player shudders at every drink, like it's tequila. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Rolling Skull
cards.rules: A giant stone skull comes down the corridor, Indiana Jones style. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6.
It rolls you flat. Drink 3.
You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and hum the theme.
Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and hum the theme.

cards.title: Skeleton Crew
cards.rules: A skeleton bachelorette party wants you to do a shot off a femur. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6.
Off the femur. Drink 3.
You knock their bones loose. Give 3.
Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ghoul Choir
cards.rules: Twelve ghouls in robes singing your name, off key. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6.
You join in. Drink 3.
You conduct them into a wall. Give 3.
Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

cards.title: Zombie Roommate
cards.rules: Your old roommate, undead, still owes you rent and still has your hoodie.

strike.even: He returns the hoodie, worse. Drink 3.
strike.advantage: You throw him out. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: He moves back in. Drink 4.

cards.title: Gym Ghoul
cards.rules: A ghoul who has skipped leg day for three hundred years. He needs a spotter. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He drops the bar on you. Drink 4.
You out-lift a corpse. Flex, then give 4.

dice.doubles: You spot him, and he thanks you. Everyone else does a squat or drinks 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Mariachi
cards.rules: Three skeletons with guitars. They won't stop until someone dances.

strike.even: Someone dances. The worst dancer drinks 3.
strike.advantage: You charm their strings into a slow one. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: You dance, badly. Drink 4.

cards.title: Your Own Eulogy
cards.rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

cards.title: The Grabbing Hand
cards.rules: A coffin lid slides open as you pass, and a hand grabs your ankle.

strike.advantage: You stamp on it and it lets go. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It pulls. Drink 3.

cards.title: The Ghost Tour
cards.rules: A ghost tour thinks you're part of the show. They want photos. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them.
You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them.
You charge them for the photos. Give 3.
Natural 20! You charge them for the photos. Give 6.

cards.title: The Crypt Keeper's Mom
cards.rules: She's been waiting up. Do you know what time it is? Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 10, then text your mom.
Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 5, then text your mom.
You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

spoils.name: Mom's Packed Lunch
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Draught.

cards.title: Death's Intern
cards.rules: Death's unpaid intern is behind on quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Filed. Drink 10.
Filed. Drink 5.
You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 5.
Natural 20! You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 10.

cards.title: The Bone Dragon
cards.rules: A dragon skeleton with a tiny hat, guarding a pile of bottle caps. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10.
It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5.
You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

cards.title: The Banshee Bride
cards.rules: She's been at the altar since 1888, and you look just like him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10.
She screams your name. Drink 5.
You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5.
Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

spoils.name: Widow's Ring
spoils.rules: +2 to boss d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

cards.title: Hangover Hydra
cards.rules: Every head you cut off grows back with a headache. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It breathes regret. Drink 10.
It breathes regret. Drink 5.
A head comes off. Give 4.
Natural 20! Clean through the neck. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: One head left, and it's the one with the migraine. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It groans at you. Drink 10.
It groans at you. Drink 5.
The last head comes off. Give 4.
Natural 20! The last head comes off. Give 8.

cards.title: The Bouncer
cards.rules: Seven feet of door guy in a tight black tee. Nobody gets past him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws you out. Finish your drink.
He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5.
You get past one arm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

jinx.name: No First Names
jinx.rule: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Bouncer's Flashlight
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, trap and relic d20s.

phases.rules: Arm wrestle your left neighbor, playing the Bouncer. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: DJ Ossuary
cards.rules: A skeleton DJ, Macarena on loop. Everyone does the Macarena, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He drops the bass on you. Drink 10.
He drops the bass on you. Drink 5.
You yank a cable. Give 4.
Natural 20! You steal the aux. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: The Aux Cord
spoils.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He drops the beat. Freestyle four lines about the table. Stop or stall: drink 4.

cards.title: The Lich Lord
cards.rules: He keeps his soul in a shot glass and he's daring you to drink it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink.
His soul is Jägermeister. Drink 5.
You smash the shot glass. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smash the shot glass. Give 8.

spoils.name: Phylactery Shot
spoils.rules: −1 max heart. Comes with a Second Wind.

spoils.name: Lich's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

phases.rules: He pours his soul into a second shot glass. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You drink the wrong one. Drink 5.
You drink both. Drink 4.
He drinks yours. Drink 3.
You smash one. Give 3.
You smash both. Give 4.
You make him drink his own soul. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Undead
jinx.rule: The jinxed player groans like a zombie before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Ghost of Closings Past
cards.rules: Every bar that ever closed on you, back, and they all want one more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They kick you out of every one. Drink 10.
They kick you out of every one. Drink 5.
You pay the last tab. They rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the whole bar. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Lost Tab
spoils.rules: Comes with a Loaded Die and a Coaster Shield.

phases.rules: Name every bar the table has been to together, in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: Last Orders
jinx.rule: The jinxed player shouts 'Last orders!' whenever a card is put aside. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: Gator Junior
cards.rules: Someone flushed a baby gator in 1995. He is not a baby. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Chomp. Drink 8, and do the gator chomp with your arms.
Chomp. Drink 4, and do the gator chomp with your arms.
You give him a belly rub. Give 4.
Natural 20! You give him a belly rub. Give 8.

cards.title: Toilet Mimic
cards.rules: The only toilet down here is licking its lips.

strike.advantage: You flush it. Give 4 to the slowest in the bathroom.
strike.disadvantage: Swirlie. Drink 4.

cards.title: Hazmat Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin in a hazmat suit who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 8.
He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 4.
You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 3.
Natural 20! You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 6.

cards.title: Sludge Bro
cards.rules: A pile of sludge in a muscle shirt asks if you even lift.

strike.advantage: You praise his gains; he slides off happy. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: You don't. Drink 4 and do five push-ups.

cards.title: Pizza Rat Prime
cards.rules: The original pizza rat, nine feet tall now and still dragging the slice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Slice to the face. Drink 8.
Slice to the face. Drink 4.
You take the slice. Give 4 to whoever wants a bite.
Natural 20! You take the slice and eat it. Give 8.

cards.title: The Drain Witch
cards.rules: She brews in the runoff, and she's offering you a sip. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You sip. Drink 6 and say it tasted fine.
You sip. Drink 3 and say it tasted fine.
You pour it back. Give 4.
Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8.

jinx.name: Drained
jinx.rule: The jinxed player can only whisper. Too loud: drink 1.

cards.title: Fatberg Spawn
cards.rules: A baby fatberg made of wet wipes and grease. It wants its mom. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6.
It clings. Drink 3.
You flush it. Give 4, and make the noise.
Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8, and make the noise.

jinx.name: Greasy Fingers
jinx.rule: The jinxed player holds their drink with two fingers only. Caught: drink 1.

cards.title: Sewer Mutant
cards.rules: A mutant with three arms and a fourth beer wants to arm-wrestle.

strike.advantage: You win, somehow. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: It has three arms. Drink 4.

cards.title: A Bitter Turtle
cards.rules: A giant turtle who taught four boys karate and got nothing. He wants a fight. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Nunchucked. Drink 4.
He lectures you on gratitude. Drink 4.
You bow first. He respects it. Give 3.
You flip him on his shell. Give 4.
You order him a pizza. He cries. Give 4.
You do a perfect crane kick. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Echo Bat
cards.rules: A bat that repeats everything you say, louder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It repeats your secret. Drink 8.
It repeats your secret. Drink 4.
You say nothing. It explodes. Give 4.
Natural 20! You say nothing. It explodes. Give 8.

jinx.name: Bat Signal
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player points at the ceiling, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: The Smell
cards.rules: Hold your nose and describe your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

cards.title: The Pipe
cards.rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

cards.title: The Echo
cards.rules: Talk for 30 seconds while everyone repeats your last word back at you. Stop: drink 4.

cards.title: Rat Race
cards.rules: Race your left neighbor: take a sip, then say 'rat' three times. Slower: drink 4.

cards.title: The Big Flush
cards.rules: Somewhere above, a whole bar flushes at once.

strike.advantage: You grab a ladder. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Swept down the pipe. Drink 3.

cards.title: Loose Grate
cards.rules: The grate under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One leg down a drain. Drink 6 on one leg.
One leg down a drain. Drink 3 on one leg.
You hop off. Give 2.
Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

cards.title: Swamp Gas
cards.rules: Somebody lit a cigarette. Down here. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Whoomph. Drink 6, and pat out your hair.
Whoomph. Drink 3, and pat out your hair.
You dive into the sludge. Give 2 to whoever you blame.
Natural 20! You dive into the sludge. Give 4 to whoever you blame.

cards.title: The Slime Slide
cards.rules: The floor tilts, and it's greased. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down the slide, face first. Drink 6.
Down the slide, face first. Drink 3.
You surf it. Give 2 to the worst surfer here.
Natural 20! You surf it. Give 4 to the worst surfer here.

cards.title: Roach Conga
cards.rules: The roaches are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6, and lead a conga to the fridge.
You conga'd. Drink 3, and lead a conga to the fridge.
You break the line. Give 3.
Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

cards.title: The Gator Gang
cards.rules: Three gators in leather jackets, and one of them has a switchblade. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your wallet. Drink 6.
They take your wallet. Drink 3.
You out-cool them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-cool them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Flushed Goldfish
cards.rules: A goldfish flushed in 2003 grew to the size of a van. It remembers.

strike.advantage: You say sorry and it forgives you. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: It remembers you. Drink 4.

cards.title: The Rat Don
cards.rules: A rat in a fedora says that's a nice drink. Shame if something happened to it. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Something happens to it. Drink 4.
You make him an offer. Pick someone to kiss your ring or drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you the don. Everyone else kisses your ring or drinks 4.

cards.title: Pipe Octopus
cards.rules: Eight arms out of eight pipes, all at once.

strike.advantage: You hex the arms into a knot. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: It grabs your drink with all eight. Drink 4.

cards.title: Hold Your Breath
cards.rules: Hold your breath for 20 seconds while the table describes the smell. Gasp early: drink 4.

cards.title: The Manhole Cover
cards.rules: The manhole cover above you is spinning loose. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands on your foot. Drink 6.
It lands on your foot. Drink 3.
You catch it like a frisbee. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You catch it like a frisbee. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: The LARPers
cards.rules: Four LARPers in foam armor think the sewer is their quest, and you're the orc. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A foam sword to the face. Drink 6, then growl.
A foam sword to the face. Drink 3, then growl.
You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 3.
Natural 20! You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 6.

cards.title: Clog Beast
cards.rules: Everything anyone ever flushed, fused into one angry clog. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It backs up on you. Drink 10.
It backs up on you. Drink 5.
You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 5.
Natural 20! You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 10.

spoils.name: Golden Plunger
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: Rat Captain
cards.rules: A rat in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Keelhauled. Drink 10, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
Keelhauled. Drink 5, and say 'aye aye, captain'.
You take his hat and his ship. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take his hat and his ship. Give 10.

spoils.name: Captain's Hat
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Loaded Die.

cards.title: The Sewer Kingpin
cards.rules: He runs every pipe from here to the river, and he's heard about you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You owe him now. Drink 10.
You owe him now. Drink 5.
You flip him. He works for you now. Give 5.
Natural 20! You flip him. He works for you now. Give 10.

spoils.name: Kingpin's Rolodex
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Smoke Bomb and a Healing Draught.

cards.title: The Sewer Siren
cards.rules: She sings from the outflow pipe, and everyone wants to follow. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You follow. Drink 10, and hum her song.
You follow. Drink 5, and hum her song.
You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 10.

spoils.name: Siren Song
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: The Fatberg
cards.rules: A hundred tons of grease and wet wipes the size of a bus, and it's angry. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 10.
It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 5.
A chunk comes off. Give 4.
Natural 20! You blast it with a fire hose. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It rolls back together, bigger. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It absorbs your shoe. Drink 5.
You flush it. Give 4.

jinx.name: Clogged
jinx.rule: The jinxed player can't say 'I' or 'me'. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Alligator Al
cards.rules: A twelve-foot gator in a bowling shirt who runs the sewer's only bar. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Al doesn't like your face. Drink 10.
Al doesn't like your face. Drink 5.
You bowl him a strike. Give 4.
Natural 20! Gutter ball, and he's in it. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: Al wants your bowling stance. Hold it on one leg while the table counts to 15. Wobble down: drink 4.

cards.title: The Plumber King
cards.rules: Crowned in a toilet seat with a plunger for a scepter. He demands tribute. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He crowns you with the seat. Finish your drink.
Plunged. Drink 5.
You snap the plunger. Give 4.
Natural 20! You snap the plunger. Give 8.

jinx.name: Plunger Hands
jinx.rule: Nobody points at anything. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Royal Wrench
spoils.rules: Traps hurt 1 less. Comes with a Coaster Shield.

phases.rules: Kneel and swear fealty to the Plumber King, in one breath, in rhyme. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: Mama Gator
cards.rules: Gator Junior's mother has heard what you did. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She adopts you. Finish your drink, then call her mom.
She sits on you, gently, for an hour. Drink 5.
You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 4.
Natural 20! You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 8.

spoils.name: Mama's Lullaby
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Draught.

phases.rules: She wants an apology. Apologize to your left neighbor for 15 seconds, sincerely. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Pipe Worm
cards.rules: Eighty years in the plumbing, and now it's as long as the city. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It wraps around you twice. Drink 10.
It wraps around you twice. Drink 5.
You tie it in a knot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tie it in a bow. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It comes up through the drain behind you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It swallows your arm. Drink 5.
It swallows your drink. Drink 4.
It hisses. Drink 3.
You plug it. Give 3.
You snake it. Give 4.
You tie it to a pipe. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Pipe Down
jinx.rule: Only the drawer may talk to the jinxed player. Anyone else does: they drink 1.

cards.title: Sommelier Kraken
cards.rules: A kraken with a wine glass in every arm, and every glass is yours.

strike.advantage: Calamari. Give 5, split however you like.
strike.disadvantage: Squeezed. Drink 5.

cards.title: Last Orders Siren
cards.rules: A siren sings one more drink, and it's beautiful. Roll d20 to resist.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You swim to her. Finish your drink.
You swim to her. Finish half your drink.
You stuff your ears with limes. Give 5.
Natural 20! You stuff your ears with limes. Give 10.

cards.title: The Drowned Regular
cards.rules: He's been at the bottom of the bar since 1987 and you're on his stool.

strike.advantage: You buy him one. He fades away. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: He takes his stool back. Drink 5 and swap seats.

cards.title: Foam Leviathan
cards.rules: A head of foam the size of a city bus rises out of the taps. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It washes over you. Drink 10, and wear the mustache.
It washes over you. Drink 5, and wear the mustache.
You blow the head off. Give 5.
Natural 20! You blow the head off. Give 10.

cards.title: Piranha Shots
cards.rules: A school of piranhas lives in the shot glasses.

strike.advantage: You net them with a coaster. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: They bite your lip. Drink 5.

cards.title: Your Merfolk Ex
cards.rules: Your ex is a merfolk now and says they're doing amazing without you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They are. Drink 8.
They are. Drink 4.
You're doing amazing too. Toast yourself, then give 5.
Natural 20! You're doing amazing too. Toast yourself, then give 10.

jinx.name: Fish Out of Water
jinx.rule: The jinxed player gasps like a fish after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Text-Them Eel
cards.rules: An eel slides up and whispers: text them. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You text them. Drink 8, and show the table your last text.
You text them. Drink 4, and show the table your last text.
You bite the eel first. Give 5.
Natural 20! You bite the eel first. Give 10.

jinx.name: Typing...
jinx.rule: The jinxed player says 'typing...' before they speak. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Tap Mimic
cards.rules: One of the taps is breathing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It pours itself into you. Drink 10.
It pours itself into you. Drink 5.
You yank it out by the handle. Pour someone a sip; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You yank it out by the handle. Pour someone a sip; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Pirate Ghost
cards.rules: A ghost pirate who drowned at this bar in 1803 wants his rum back. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes it in blood. Drink 10.
He takes it in blood. Drink 5.
You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 5.
Natural 20! You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 10.

jinx.name: Pirate Tongue
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'arr'. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Snorkel Shark
cards.rules: A shark in a snorkel mask, circling the pool table.

strike.advantage: You hit it with a pool cue. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: It takes a bite of your shoe. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Drowned Choir
cards.rules: Hum a song until the table names it. 20 seconds. Nobody gets it: drink 5.

cards.title: Rising Water
cards.rules: The water's at your chin. Hold your breath for 30 seconds. Breathe early: drink 5.

cards.title: The Last Round
cards.rules: Last round's on you: name everyone's drink order from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Sea Shanty
cards.rules: Lead the table in a sea shanty. If nobody joins in by the second line, drink 5.

cards.title: Rip Current
cards.rules: The floor is a river now. Roll d20 to swim for it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swept away. Drink 8.
Swept away. Drink 4.
You ride it out. Give 3 to whoever's drowning in their drink.
Natural 20! You ride it out. Give 6 to whoever's drowning in their drink.

cards.title: Barnacle Stool
cards.rules: You sat down. Now you can't stand up. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fused to it. Drink 8, and stay seated until your next turn.
Fused to it. Drink 4, and stay seated until your next turn.
You rip free, mostly. Give 3.
Natural 20! You rip free, mostly. Give 6.

cards.title: Undertow Tap
cards.rules: You lean in for a pour and the tap pulls you under. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed. Drink 8, holding your breath first.
Swallowed. Drink 4, holding your breath first.
You kick off the bar. Give 3.
Natural 20! You kick off the bar. Give 6.

cards.title: The Drain Vortex
cards.rules: Someone pulled the plug on the whole room.

strike.advantage: You reverse the swirl with a wave. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Round and round. Spin twice, then drink 5.

cards.title: Happy Hour Eels
cards.rules: Two eels in party hats want to buy you a drink. You know what that means. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bitten, twice. Drink 8.
Bitten, twice. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You tie them in a knot. Give 8.

cards.title: Mermaid Bachelorettes
cards.rules: A mermaid bachelorette party in sashes, and they're out of prosecco. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take yours. Drink 8.
They take yours. Drink 4.
You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 4.
Natural 20! You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 8.

cards.rules: A bouncer made of kelp. Your name's not on the waterlogged list.

strike.advantage: You talk your way past. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: He wraps you up and throws you in. Drink 5.

cards.rules: A bro so covered in barnacles he's mostly reef. He wants to arm wrestle. Roll 2d6.

You scrape him off the bar. Arm wrestle anyone; the loser drinks 5.

dice.doubles: He's actually nice. Everyone else drinks 5 to the bro.

cards.title: Jellyfish Shots
cards.rules: A tray of glowing jellyfish shots drifts past. Grab one. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Stung. Drink 5.
Stung twice. Drink 5.
That was a real jellyfish. Drink 5.
Lime jello. Give 4.
Blue raspberry. Give 4.
You grab the whole tray. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Bail Out
cards.rules: Mime bailing water out of the booth for 20 seconds without laughing. Laugh: drink 5.

cards.title: Floating Stools
cards.rules: The bar stools float now, and one is drifting at your knees. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It takes your legs out. Drink 8.
It takes your legs out. Drink 4.
You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Fishing Charter
cards.rules: Six dads on a fishing charter, lost since Tuesday, still casting. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hooked by the ear. Drink 8.
Hooked by the ear. Drink 4.
You point them at the deep end. Give 4.
Natural 20! You point them at the deep end. Give 8.

cards.rules: She's run a tab since the flood, and she's settling it on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Settled. Drink 12.
Settled. Drink 6.
She pays you in pearls. Hand out 6 like they're pearls.
Natural 20! She pays you in pearls. Hand out 12 like they're pearls.

spoils.name: Sea Hag's Pearl
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Hag's Tab
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Comes with a Loaded Die.

cards.title: Shark Bartender
cards.rules: A shark in a vest, polishing glasses with its teeth, is cutting someone off. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's you. Drink 12.
It's you. Drink 6.
You punch it on the nose. Give 6 to whoever should be cut off.
Natural 20! You punch it on the nose. Give 12 to whoever should be cut off.

cards.title: The Deep One
cards.rules: Something under the bar has been drinking every spill for a century. Roll d20.

It drinks you a bit. Drink 6.
You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 6.
Natural 20! You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 12.

spoils.name: The Deep Pint
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Ambushes hurt 1 less.

cards.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
cards.rules: He hasn't seen a soul in forty years, and he's not letting you leave. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He tells you about the forty years. Drink 12 while someone tells you about theirs.
He tells you about the forty years. Drink 6 while someone tells you about theirs.
You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 6.
Natural 20! You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 12.

cards.title: Deep Fryer Demon
cards.rules: It'll fry anything. It's looking at your hand.

strike.advantage: You freeze the oil with a spell. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: Battered. Drink 5.

cards.title: Line Cook Golem
cards.rules: Seven feet of burns and tattoos, ten tickets deep, and you're in the way. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Behind! Drink 10.
Behind! Drink 5.
You run his food. He respects you. Give 5.
Natural 20! You run his food. He respects you. Give 10.

cards.title: Sentient Sourdough
cards.rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10.
It rises over you. Drink 5.
You punch it down. Give 5 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.
Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.

cards.title: Garlic Breath Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith that only ever exhales. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You'll taste it for a week. Drink 8.
You'll taste it for a week. Drink 4.
You hold your breath. Breathe on someone; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Breathe on someone; they drink 10.

jinx.name: Garlic Breath
jinx.rule: The jinxed player covers their mouth to talk. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Expo
cards.rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Plates everywhere. Drink 5.
You drop table six's steak. Drink 5.
You burn your palm on a plate. Drink 5.
Order up. Give 4.
Order up, hot and fast. Give 5.
You run six plates at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Food Critic Ghoul
cards.rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
One star. Drink 5, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 4.
Natural 20! You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 8.

cards.title: Cold Room Yeti
cards.rules: Something lives in the cold room, and it ate all the shrimp.

strike.advantage: You lock it in. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: Cold hug. Drink 5.

cards.rules: Something under the dish pit water has been eating forks.

strike.even: It burps up a fork. Drink 3.
strike.advantage: You bless the water and it sinks. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: It eats your fork. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Screaming Chef
cards.rules: A ghost chef who calls everything raw. It's not even food. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 10.
You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 5.
You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5.
Natural 20! You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10.

jinx.name: Idiot Sandwich
jinx.rule: The jinxed player answers to 'idiot sandwich' only. Answer to their name: drink 1.

cards.title: Rogue Rotisserie
cards.rules: Twelve chickens on a spit, turning, and turning toward you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Basted. Drink 5.
You carve your way out. Carve someone a drumstick; they drink 5.

dice.doubles: Chicken for everyone. Everyone else drinks 5 with a mouthful.

cards.title: Yes, Chef
cards.rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Four Plates
cards.rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

cards.title: The Hot Sauce Wall
cards.rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Pitch
cards.rules: Pitch the table a new dish in 20 seconds. Fewer than half would eat it: drink 5.

cards.title: Grease Fire
cards.rules: Somebody threw water on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8.
Singed. Drink 4.
You smother it with a lid. Give 3 to whoever looks hot.
Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6 to whoever looks hot.

cards.title: Wet Floor
cards.rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
You skate it. Give 3.
Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

cards.title: The Swinging Door
cards.rules: One door, in and out, and a server is coming through with a full tray.

strike.advantage: You spin past. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Tray to the face. Drink 5.

cards.rules: The guard is off the mandoline and it's slicing on its own. Roll d20.

Thinly sliced. Drink 4.
You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 3.
Natural 20! You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 6.

They take your fries too. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bottomless. Drink 8.
Bottomless. Drink 4.
You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 8.

cards.rules: The ghost of every fish ever microwaved in the break room. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You smell like it now. Drink 10.
You smell like it now. Drink 5.
You open a window. Give 5 to whoever brought fish to work.
Natural 20! You open a window. Give 10 to whoever brought fish to work.

cards.title: The Rat Chef

strike.advantage: You compliment the chef. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: He serves you. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Ticket Machine
cards.rules: The ticket printer won't stop. Two hundred orders, all for you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You're in the weeds. Drink 5.
Heard. Shout 'Heard!' and give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You 86 everything. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Order
cards.rules: Repeat back every drink at the table, in order, from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.rules: Somebody left a pan on the burner, and the handle's glowing.

strike.advantage: You grab a towel like a pro. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: You grab it. Drink 5, then blow on your hand.

cards.rules: Two food truck guys broke in to rob your walk-in. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They sell you your own food. Drink 8.
They sell you your own food. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You chase them off with a ladle. Give 8.

The pan. Drink 6.

Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 12.

Filleted. Drink 6.

Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

Natural 20! You surf it out. Give 4 to whoever would have panicked.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down you go. Drink 4.
Down you go. Drink 2.
You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 2.
Natural 20! You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 4.

You're in the brochure. Drink 2.
You lead them into a vat. Give 2.
Natural 20! You lead them into a vat. Give 4.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hush money. Drink 4.
Hush money. Drink 2.
You take a cut. Give 2.
Natural 20! You take a cut. Give 4.

strike.disadvantage: It crumbles all over you. Drink 3.

It haunts your palate. Drink 3.

Natural 20! You hold it to the light. Give 6 to whoever's hazy right now.

He reverses over your foot. Drink 3.
You dodge. Give 2.
You take the keys. Give 3.
You wave him into a vat. Give 3.
You ride the forks. Everyone else drinks 1.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It wraps your ankles. Drink 4.
It wraps your ankles. Drink 2.
You stamp it flat. Give 2 to whoever jumped.
Natural 20! You stamp it flat. Give 4 to whoever jumped.

cards.title: Homebrew Club
cards.rules: Four beards with growlers want your opinion. All of it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You give it. Drink 4.
You give it. Drink 2.
You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 2.
Natural 20! You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 4.

Natural 20! You call it his best. He weeps. Give 8.

Natural 20! You cork it back in. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

Natural 20! You take their tap. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 8.

Natural 20! She asks for the recipe. Make one up out loud, then give 8.

It blows its lid on you. Drink 4.

Too bitter. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You dry-hop the king. Give 10.

He lectures you to death. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You out-snob him. Everyone else drinks 3.

Natural 20! You tie its taps in a knot. Give 10.

Free beer for life. Give 3.

It tastes like the freezer. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You get him to the church. Pick a best man; they drink 8.

He pours you a glacier. Drink 4.

Natural 20! You tip him. He warms right up. Give 8.
