cards.rules: A swan carved in ice, from a wedding nobody came back from. It moves. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It pecks. Drink 8.
It pecks. Drink 4.
You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 8.

jinx.name: Frozen
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player says 'freeze', the last to stop moving drinks 1.

cards.title: The Mammoth
cards.rules: Thawed out of the ice cream tubs and furious about the last ten thousand years. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Trampled. Drink 8.
Trampled. Drink 4.
You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 8.

cards.title: Hypothermia Hal
cards.rules: Hal is fine. Hal is great, actually. Hal has taken his shirt off. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 8.
Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 4.
You get Hal a coat. Give 4 to the least-dressed player here.
Natural 20! You get Hal a coat. Give 8 to the least-dressed player here.

jinx.name: Chattering Teeth
jinx.rule: The jinxed player chatters their teeth before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Margarita Elemental
cards.rules: A slushie with salt on its rim and nothing to lose. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It brain-freezes you. Drink 8.
It brain-freezes you. Drink 4.
You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 3.
Natural 20! You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 6.

cards.title: The Shiver
cards.rules: Say the coldest thing you've ever said to an ex, true or not. Nobody winces: drink 4.

cards.title: Frozen Solid
cards.rules: Strike your coldest pose and hold it, dead still, for 15 seconds. Move: drink 4.

cards.title: The Icebreaker
cards.rules: Deliver your best icebreaker to your left neighbor. The table groans: drink 4.

cards.title: The Cold Open
cards.rules: Name a cold drink for every letter of COLD in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Slippery Floor
cards.rules: Black ice, right where the door used to be. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flat on your back. Drink 6.
Flat on your back. Drink 3.
You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 3.
Natural 20! You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 6.

cards.title: The Door Shuts
cards.rules: Click. The handle's on the outside.

strike.advantage: You find the safety knob. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: You're in here now. Drink 3.

cards.title: Icicle Drop
cards.rules: The ceiling is all icicles, and you just sneezed. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One finds you. Drink 6.
One finds you. Drink 3.
You step aside. It shatters. Give 3.
Natural 20! You step aside. It shatters. Give 6.

cards.title: Tongue on the Pole
cards.rules: A metal shelf, a dare, and you've already done it.

strike.advantage: You breathe it free. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Stuck. Drink 3, and talk like it for one sentence.

cards.title: The Penguin Gang
cards.rules: Six penguins in matching tuxes, and they say you're on their ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 6.
Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 3.
You out-waddle them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-waddle them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Frozen Peas
cards.rules: A bag split open and now there are peas everywhere, and they're organized. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Peas down your shirt. Drink 6.
Peas down your shirt. Drink 3.
You ice your knee with them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You ice your knee with them. Give 6.

cards.title: Popsicle Golem
cards.rules: A golem of a thousand stuck-together popsicles, in every flavor you hate.

strike.advantage: You sweet-talk it into melting. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Banana. Drink 4.

cards.title: The Thawed Caveman
cards.rules: A caveman thawed out and wants to know what a phone is. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He clubs your phone. Drink 4.
You show him a meme. Grunt at someone; they drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you chief. Everyone else grunts and drinks 4.

cards.title: Ice Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin juggling ice cubes, and aiming them down your back.

strike.advantage: You juggle better. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Down your shirt. Drink 4.

cards.title: Chattering Teeth
cards.rules: Say 'she sells seashells' three times through chattering teeth. Fumble it: drink 4.

cards.title: The Ice Machine
cards.rules: The ice machine is jammed and shaking. Roll d20 before it blows.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 6.
Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 3.
You unplug it in time. Give 3, ice cold.
Natural 20! You unplug it in time. Give 6, ice cold.

cards.title: Ski Lodge Crew
cards.rules: Five people in ski gear who never made it to the slopes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They make you join their shot ski. Drink 6.
They make you join their shot ski. Drink 3.
You send them to the hot tub. Give 3.
Natural 20! You send them to the hot tub. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ice Queen
cards.rules: She rules the freezer, and she has never once let anything go. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She freezes you out. Drink 10.
She freezes you out. Drink 5.
You sing at her. She thaws. Give 5.
Natural 20! You sing at her. She thaws. Give 10.

cards.title: The Abominable Barback
cards.rules: Eight feet of white fur and an ice scoop, and you just asked for no ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 10.
He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 5.
You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 10.

cards.title: The Enforcer
cards.rules: The mob keeps him in here for people who owe. You don't. He doesn't care. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He puts you on ice. Drink 10.
He puts you on ice. Drink 5.
You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 10.

cards.title: The Freezer Witch
cards.rules: She keeps her ex in a block of ice, and there's room for one more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're on ice. Drink 10.
You're on ice. Drink 5.
You thaw the ex. Give 5 to whoever has an ex on ice.
Natural 20! You thaw the ex. Give 10 to whoever has an ex on ice.

cards.title: The Walk-in
cards.rules: The freezer itself wakes up, and the door shuts, and the light goes out. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drops ten degrees. Drink 10.
It drops ten degrees. Drink 5.
You unplug it at the wall. Give 5.
Natural 20! You kick the door off. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The light's out. Eyes shut, touch the nose of your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Snow Bartender
cards.rules: He pours with snow and he serves only frozen drinks, and he never stops. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You order a slushie. Finish your drink.
Frozen daiquiri, straight to the brain. Drink 5.
You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 10.

spoils.name: Frost Shaker
spoils.rules: Comes with a Healing Draught and a Bar Tab.

phases.rules: He serves the brain freeze. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Brain freeze. Drink 5.
You drink it slowly, like an adult. Give 5.

dice.doubles: You hand it back. He freezes solid. Give 7.

jinx.name: Brrr
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'brrr'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Absolute Zero
cards.rules: The coldest thing there is. It doesn't move. Nothing near it does either. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You stop moving. Drink 10.
You stop moving. Drink 5.
You rub your hands together. It's enough. Give 5.
Natural 20! You light a match. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Chattering
jinx.rule: The jinxed player's teeth chatter whenever they speak. Forget: drink 1.

phases.rules: Freeze while the table counts to 15. Move, laugh or blink: drink 4.

cards.title: The Ice Cream Man
cards.rules: His van's in here somehow, and the music is playing in a minor key. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You get in the van. Finish your drink.
Rocky road. Drink 5.
You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 5.
Natural 20! You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 10.

phases.rules: He plays the jingle. Name six ice cream flavors in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

cards.title: The Frozen Ex
cards.rules: Your ex, frozen at the exact moment you broke up, now thawing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 10.
They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 5.
You say you've moved on, and mean it. They shatter. Give 5.
Natural 20! You both laugh about it. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Closure
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: They want closure. Say three nice things about an ex in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: As I Was Saying
jinx.rule: The jinxed player starts every sentence with 'As I was saying'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Pigeon King
cards.rules: A pigeon in a bottle-cap crown, with a thousand subjects on the railing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! His subjects swoop. Drink 10.
His subjects swoop. Drink 5.
You throw the crown off the roof. Crown someone; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You throw the crown off the roof. Crown someone; they drink 10.

cards.title: The Rooftop DJ
cards.rules: He's playing a sunset set at midnight and he takes requests personally. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: He drops your ringtone into the mix. Drink 5.
He plays your ex's song. Drink 5.
An air horn, in your ear. Drink 5.
You request a banger. Give 4.
You unplug him. Give 5.
You take the decks. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Wind
cards.rules: Not a monster. Just the wind, forty floors up, and it wants your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 10.
It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 5.
You lean into it like a music video. Hair flip, then give 5.
Natural 20! You lean into it like a music video. Hair flip, then give 10.

jinx.name: Windswept
jinx.rule: The jinxed player flips their hair before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Seagull
cards.rules: It's eyeing your fries. You don't have fries. It's eyeing you.

strike.advantage: You stare it down. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: It takes a bite. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Influencer Golem
cards.rules: Built from ring lights, it needs one more take, and you're in the shot. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Take forty. Drink 5.
You knock over the ring light. Give 5 to whoever's posing.

dice.doubles: It films you instead. Everyone else drinks 5 for the content.

cards.title: The Neighbor
cards.rules: A man in a bathrobe on the next roof, holding a phone and threatening to call. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He calls. Drink 10.
He calls. Drink 5.
You invite him over. Pick someone to be the neighbor; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You invite him over. Pick someone to be the neighbor; they drink 10.

jinx.name: Indoor Voices
jinx.rule: The jinxed player may only whisper. Speak up: drink 1.

cards.title: The Gargoyle
cards.rules: A gargoyle on the ledge, and it's only been pretending to be stone. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drops on you. Drink 10.
It drops on you. Drink 5.
You push it off the ledge. Give 5 to whoever's still as stone.
Natural 20! You push it off the ledge. Give 10 to whoever's still as stone.

jinx.name: Stone Still
jinx.rule: The jinxed player sits perfectly still while anyone else rolls. Moves: drink 1.

cards.title: The Thunderstorm
cards.rules: The sky opens, and nobody brought an umbrella. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Soaked to the bone. Drink 5.
You dance in it. Everyone dances or drinks 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! Lightning strikes your drink and makes it better. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Proposal
cards.rules: A guy is proposing to his girlfriend at the railing, and you're filming.

strike.advantage: You hype him up. She says yes. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: She says no, and it's somehow your fault. Drink 5.

cards.title: Rooftop Raccoon
cards.rules: It's in the garnish tray, eating every lime, and it's not leaving. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It hisses. Drink 10.
It hisses. Drink 5.
You bribe it with a cherry. Give 4 to whoever would eat the limes.
Natural 20! You bribe it with a cherry. Give 8 to whoever would eat the limes.

cards.title: To the City
cards.rules: Give a toast to the city in 15 seconds, no 'um'. Say 'um': drink 5.

cards.title: Skyline Trivia
cards.rules: Name five cities with famous skylines in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Slow Dance
cards.rules: 10-second slow dance with your right neighbor, eyes locked. Either laughs: you drink 5.

cards.title: Golden Hour
cards.rules: Give the table your best 'candid' pose. The table votes it fake: drink 5.

cards.title: The Ledge
cards.rules: You lean over for the view, and the railing leans with you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You see your life flash. Drink 8.
You see your life flash. Drink 4.
You step back, cool. Give 4 to whoever gasped.
Natural 20! You step back, cool. Give 8 to whoever gasped.

cards.title: The Sprinklers
cards.rules: The roof's sprinklers come on, all at once.

strike.advantage: You stop the water with a wave. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Drenched. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Loose Tile
cards.rules: A loose roof tile, slippery from the rain, right under your foot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You slide. Drink 8.
You slide. Drink 4.
You land it like a parkour video. Shout 'parkour!' and give 4.
Natural 20! You land it like a parkour video. Shout 'parkour!' and give 8.

cards.title: The Heat Lamp
cards.rules: You stood under the patio heater too long, and now you're on fire, slightly.

strike.advantage: You stop, drop and roll. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Your eyebrows go. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Rooftop Yoga Class
cards.rules: Twenty people in downward dog, and you're in the way of their sunset. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They make you join. Drink 8.
They make you join. Drink 4.
You namaste out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You namaste out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Pigeon Squadron
cards.rules: Twelve pigeons in a V formation, on a strafing run. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8.
Direct hit. Drink 4.
You duck behind the bar. Give 4.
Natural 20! You duck behind the bar. Give 8.

cards.title: The Rogue Drone
cards.rules: Somebody's drone is filming you, and now it's dive-bombing.

strike.even: It films your bad side. Drink 3.
strike.advantage: You swat it into the pool. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: Hit in the head, on camera. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Hot Tub Wizard
cards.rules: An old man in the hot tub says he's a wizard and wants your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's a wizard. Drink 10.
He's a wizard. Drink 5.
He's just an old man. Give 5 to whoever believed him.
Natural 20! He's just an old man. Give 10 to whoever believed him.

cards.title: The Fireworks
cards.rules: Someone's lighting fireworks off the roof, badly.

strike.advantage: A heart in the sky. Make a wish and give 5.
strike.disadvantage: One goes sideways at you. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Heckler
cards.rules: A guy on the next roof heckles you. Roast him back in 10 seconds. Weak roast: drink 5.

cards.title: The Awning
cards.rules: The awning above you is full of rainwater, and sagging. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Drenched. Drink 8.
Drenched. Drink 4.
You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Wedding Shoot
cards.rules: A wedding party wants the skyline, and you're in every shot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the album forever. Drink 8.
You're in the album forever. Drink 4.
You show them a better spot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show them a better spot. Give 8.

cards.title: The Penthouse Owner
cards.rules: He owns the building, the roof and, he thinks, you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He has you thrown off the guest list. Drink 12.
He has you thrown off the guest list. Drink 6.
You buy the floor below his. Give 6 to the richest-looking player here.
Natural 20! You buy the floor below his. Give 12 to the richest-looking player here.

spoils.name: Penthouse Key
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Healing Draught.

cards.title: The Gargoyle King
cards.rules: The city's biggest gargoyle. Every other one on the roof just turned to look. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stone fist. Drink 12.
Stone fist. Drink 6.
You crown yourself. Give 6, split among your subjects.
Natural 20! You crown yourself. Give 12, split among your subjects.

cards.title: The Storm Chaser
cards.rules: He chases storms with a lightning rod, and tonight he brought you one. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Struck. Drink 12.
Struck. Drink 6.
You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 6.
Natural 20! You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 12.

spoils.name: Storm Coat
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Traps hurt 1 less.

cards.title: The Helicopter Pilot
cards.rules: He landed on the roof and won't leave until somebody pays. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're paying. Drink 12.
You're paying. Drink 6.
Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 6.
Natural 20! Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 12.

cards.title: The Last Call Lich
cards.rules: A bony hand rings the bell. It's last call forever unless you kill it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Closing time. Everyone drinks 8.
Closing time. Everyone drinks 4.
It flickers. Give 5.
Natural 20! The music comes back on. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: It rings the bell. Out-shout your left neighbor: 'One more!' The table judges. Lose: drink 4.
One bony hand left on the bell. Everyone raises a glass. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The bell rings. Everyone drinks 8.
The bell rings. Everyone drinks 4.
You take the bell. Everyone else drinks 4.
Natural 20! You take the bell. Everyone else drinks 8.

cards.title: The Bartender Below
cards.rules: It knows your usual. It knows what you did. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cuts you off. Drink 12.
It cuts you off. Drink 6.
You tip it. It staggers. Give 5.
Natural 20! You rob the tip jar. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: It wants your order in three seconds, with a straight face. The table judges. Fail: drink 4.
It reaches for the cut-off bell. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Cut off. Finish your drink, then a fresh one.
Cut off. Finish your drink.
You tip big. It weeps. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tip big. It weeps. Give 10.

cards.title: The Final Tab
cards.rules: Every drink you've ever ordered, itemized, four feet long, and it has teeth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Itemized. Drink 10.
Itemized. Drink 5.
You dispute a charge. Give 5.
Natural 20! Comped. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Split the bill: say what everyone at the table drank tonight, in ten seconds. Miss one: drink 4.
The total comes in. It's a lot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You pay. Everyone drinks 8.
You pay. Everyone drinks 4.
You dine and dash. Give 6.
Natural 20! You dine and dash. Give 12.

cards.title: The House Lights
cards.rules: The lights come up, and everyone looks like that. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You saw yourself. Drink 12.
You saw yourself. Drink 6.
You smash a bulb. Give 5.
Natural 20! Darkness again. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Everyone looks at you. Strike a pose and hold it while the table counts to ten. Break: drink 4.
The last bulb flickers. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Full brightness. Everyone drinks 8.
Full brightness. Everyone drinks 4.
Darkness. Everyone else drinks 4.
Natural 20! Darkness. Everyone else drinks 8.

jinx.name: Lit Up
jinx.rule: The jinxed player squints at everyone. Caught with their eyes wide open: drink 1.

cards.title: The 2 a.m. Kebab
cards.rules: It's been turning since 8 p.m. It knew you'd come. It's the size of a door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drop it on the floor and eat it anyway. Drink 10.
Garlic sauce, everywhere. Drink 5.
You carve it down to the spit. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing, standing. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Order for the table in one breath: what everyone wants on theirs. Stumble: drink 4.
It's down to the spit, and it's still turning. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Garlic sauce in your eye. Drink 10.
Garlic sauce in your eye. Drink 5.
You eat the last bite. Give 6.
Natural 20! You eat the last bite. Give 12.

cards.title: Surge Pricing
cards.rules: The ride home costs $94 and it's sentient. It's circling the block, laughing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Surge goes up again. Drink 10.
Surge goes up again. Drink 5.
You find a driver who's going your way. Give 5.
Natural 20! Free ride. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Haggle a fare with your left neighbor, playing the driver, for ten seconds. They refuse: drink 4.
It's three minutes away, forever. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Ride cancelled. Everyone drinks 8.
Ride cancelled. Everyone drinks 4.
Five stars. Give 6.
Natural 20! Five stars. Give 12.

jinx.name: Surge
jinx.rule: The jinxed player adds 'plus tax' to every drink they're given. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Group Chat
cards.rules: Tomorrow's group chat, awake early, reading tonight back to you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Someone posts the video. Drink 12.
Someone posts the video. Drink 6.
You leave the chat. It can't follow. Give 5.
Natural 20! You mute it forever. Everyone else drinks 4.

jinx.name: Muted
jinx.rule: The jinxed player can only mime. Say a word: drink 1.

phases.rules: Read your last sent text out loud to the table. Refuse: drink 4.
Someone's typing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's the video. Everyone drinks 8.
It's the video. Everyone drinks 4.
It's a meme. You're safe. Give 6.
Natural 20! It's a meme. You're safe. Give 12.

cards.title: The Morning After
cards.rules: Your hangover from tomorrow came back in time to stop you. It's enormous. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands a preview. Drink 10 and a glass of water.
It lands a preview. Drink 5 and a glass of water.
You promise it a greasy breakfast. It backs off. Give 5.
Natural 20! You were never going to have a hangover. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Drink a full glass of water without stopping. Stop: drink 4.
It rises with the sun. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sunrise. Everyone drinks 8.
Sunrise. Everyone drinks 4.
Blackout curtains. Give 6.
Natural 20! Blackout curtains. Give 12.

cards.title: Barbarian
cards.rules: Rage first. Questions never. +2 to boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more. Wears Rusty Greataxe.

evolves.title: Berserker
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. +2 to elite and boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Brute
evolves.rules: +4 max hearts. +1 to boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more.

evolves.title: Warlord
evolves.rules: +3 max hearts. +2 to elite d20s. +3 to boss d20s.

evolves.title: Juggernaut
evolves.rules: +5 max hearts. +1 to boss d20s.

cards.title: Rogue
cards.rules: Has your wallet. +2 to trap and relic d20s. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Smoke Bomb. Wears Shiv.

evolves.title: Cutpurse
evolves.rules: +1 to monster d20s. +3 to trap d20s. +2 to relic d20s. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Card Sharp
evolves.rules: +2 to trap d20s. +3 to relic d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. +1 satchel slot.

evolves.title: Shadow
evolves.rules: +2 to monster d20s. +3 to trap and relic d20s. +2 satchel slots.

power.name: Shadowstep
power.rules: Take the edge in a fight

evolves.title: High Roller
evolves.rules: +1 to every battle d20. +3 to relic d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. +2 satchel slots.

power.name: Sneak Attack
power.rules: Take the edge in a fight

cards.title: Cleric
cards.rules: Blesses every drink, loudly. Every heal heals 1 more. Wears Holy Vestments.

evolves.title: Priest
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: Battle Priest
evolves.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

evolves.title: High Priest
evolves.rules: +2 max hearts. Every heal heals 2 more.

evolves.title: Inquisitor
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +1 to ambush d20s. +2 to boss d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: Wizard
cards.rules: Reads the menu like a spellbook. −2 max hearts. Starts with 2 Loaded Dice. Wears Pointy Hat.

evolves.title: Sorcerer
evolves.rules: −1 max heart. A fresh Loaded Die whenever a boss falls.

evolves.title: Illusionist
evolves.rules: −1 max heart. A fresh Smoke Bomb whenever a boss falls.

evolves.title: Archmage
evolves.rules: +1 to every battle d20. A fresh Loaded Die whenever a boss falls.

evolves.title: Grand Illusionist
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. +2 to ambush d20s. A fresh Smoke Bomb whenever a boss falls. +1 satchel slot.

cards.title: Bard
cards.rules: Brought a guitar. Nobody asked. +1 max heart. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Wears Battered Lute.

evolves.title: Minstrel
evolves.rules: +1 max heart. Natural 20 on 18 to 20.

cards.title: Brad Knows the Owner
cards.rules: Brad's cousin knows the owner, so the Quarter-Zips cut in. Drop a bigger name. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 6.
His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 3.
The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 3 to the Brad of the table.
Natural 20! The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 6 to the Brad of the table.

cards.title: Chad's Fake ID
cards.rules: You and your left neighbor (Chad) do 10 seconds of Canadian each. Chad wins: drink 3.

cards.title: We're Together
cards.rules: Thad cuts in, telling the bouncer 'we're together'. You're not. Roll 2d6 to argue.

outcomes.instruction: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3.
The bouncer believes you. Pick someone you're 'together' with; they drink 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! The bouncer sends them to the back. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Group Name
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips have a group name, a hashtag and matching vests. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They look cooler than you. Drink 6.
They look cooler than you. Drink 3.
You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 3.
Natural 20! You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 6.

jinx.name: Champ
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player 'Champ', like Brad does. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Guest List
cards.rules: Brad is on the list. You're on a napkin the bouncer is holding. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: The napkin blows away. Drink 3.
The bouncer blows his nose on the napkin. Drink 3.
The napkin holds up. Give 2.
You're on the list, and Brad's spelled wrong. Give 3.
You're on the list twice. Give 3.
Brad's off the list. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Cover Charge
cards.rules: Chad tells the bouncer you're paying for all the Quarter-Zips. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The bouncer believes him. Drink 6.
The bouncer believes him. Drink 3.
The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 3, twice, to the same person.
Natural 20! The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 6, twice, to the same person.

cards.title: The Hand Stamp
cards.rules: Thad licked his hand stamp onto Brad's hand, and they want to try it on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It works on you. Drink 6.
It works on you. Drink 3.
You wash it off in a puddle. Stamp someone's hand; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You wash it off in a puddle. Stamp someone's hand; they drink 6.

cards.title: Rock, Paper, Brad

cards.title: Gelatinous Shot

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6, no hands.
It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands.
You eat your way out. Give 3.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

cards.title: Rats in a Coat
cards.rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Their ID is better than yours. Drink 6.
Their ID is better than yours. Drink 3.
Bounced. Give 3 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.
Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6 to whoever looks most like a rat in a coat.

cards.title: Mold Elemental
cards.rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 6 and cough on both neighbors.
You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor.
Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3.
Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

cards.title: Drunk Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6 and hug your right neighbor.
He wins both. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor.
He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2.
Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Barback

strike.even: He hands you a dry one. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: He finds a perfect one. Give 3, with a lime.
strike.disadvantage: He throws one at your eye. Drink 3.

cards.title: Possessed Mop

strike.even: It mops your feet. Drink 2 and lift them.
strike.advantage: You snap the handle. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It mops your face. Drink 3.

cards.title: Keg Spider
cards.rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back.
Squished. Give 3.
Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 6.

cards.title: Tab Goblin
cards.rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8.
It collects. Drink 4.
You stiff it. Give 3 to whoever owes you money.
Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

cards.title: Goblin Shaman
cards.rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6.
The chant works. Drink 3.
You blow out the sage. Give 3 to whoever smells most like it.
Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6 to whoever smells most like it.

jinx.name: Goblin Tongue
jinx.rule: The jinxed player speaks of themself in the third person. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Cask Bat
cards.rules: A bat lives in the empty cask and it hates the lights.

strike.even: It flaps past your ear. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: You shoo it into a bucket. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It gets tangled in your hair. Drink 3.

cards.title: Clipboard Troll
cards.rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

cards.title: The Riddling Tap
cards.rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

cards.title: The Stuck Door
cards.rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

cards.title: Keg Stand-Off
cards.rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor. You blink or laugh first: drink 3.

cards.title: Sticky Floor
cards.rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2, and stay one shoe down until your next turn.
You peel free. Give 2.
Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

cards.title: Tripwire
cards.rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4.
You eat the stairs. Drink 2.
You hop it. Give 2 to the clumsiest player here.
Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to the clumsiest player here.

cards.title: Rolling Kegs
cards.rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6, lying down if you can.
Flattened. Drink 3, lying down if you can.
You dive clear. Give 2 to whoever didn't flinch.
Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4 to whoever didn't flinch.

cards.title: Loose Tap Handles
cards.rules: A rack of novelty tap handles is right above your head. It's swaying.

strike.even: A foam one bonks you. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: You dodge, then catch the shark. Give 2.
strike.disadvantage: A plastic shark to the skull. Drink 3.

jinx.name: Thumb Master
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player puts a thumb on the table, the last to copy drinks 1.

cards.title: Lost Bridesmaids
cards.rules: Two lost bridesmaids have decided you're the groom. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! First dance. Drink 4, then sway with your right neighbor.
First dance. Drink 2, then sway with your right neighbor.
You point them upstairs. Give 2.
Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

cards.title: The Rat Pack

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They do it their way. Drink 4.
They do it their way. Drink 2.
You heckle them offstage. Give 2.
Natural 20! You heckle them offstage. Give 4.

cards.title: Fryer Oil Ooze
cards.rules: Twenty years of fryer oil got up and walked. It smells like Tuesday.

strike.advantage: You salt it with a spell and it shrivels. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It hugs you. Drink 3, then wipe your hands on your jeans.

outcomes.instruction: The tower falls. Drink 3.
You tip him a coin. Stack two empty glasses on someone's head, then give 3.

dice.doubles: He stacks glasses on everyone else instead. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Cobweb Bartender
cards.rules: A bartender made of cobwebs slides you something cloudy.

strike.advantage: You bless the glass and the cobwebs fall away. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It's mostly spider. Drink 3 and shiver.

cards.title: The Low Beam
cards.rules: Your right neighbor holds out an arm as the beam. Limbo under it. Touch it: drink 3.

cards.title: Loose Floorboard
cards.rules: One board in the cellar floor is not like the others. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It springs up and smacks you. Drink 4.
It springs up and smacks you. Drink 2.
You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 2.
Natural 20! You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 4.

cards.title: The Stag Party
cards.rules: Eight men in matching shirts, one in a veil, all looking for a ninth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Recruited. Drink 4, then give a best-man toast.
Recruited. Drink 2, then give a best-man toast.
You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 2.
Natural 20! You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 4.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bust. Drink 6.
Bust. Drink 3.
Cherries. Give 2.
Natural 20! Cherries. Give 4.

cards.title: Mimic Cooler

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8.
It bites. Drink 4.
Cold ones, and something useful. Hand someone a cold one; give 3.
Natural 20! Cold ones, and something useful. Hand someone a cold one; give 6.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Every light goes out. Drink 6 in the dark.
Every light goes out. Drink 3 in the dark.
The jukebox comes on. Give 3, then pick a song.
Natural 20! The jukebox comes on. Give 6, then pick a song.

cards.rules: He's been down here since the cellar was a bar. He'll trade a story for a story.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The coins don't budge. Drink 6.
The coins don't budge. Drink 3.
A coin drops. Give 2.
Natural 20! A coin drops. Give 4.

cards.title: Mimic Keg

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 6.
It bites. Drink 3.
It burps up a prize. Give 2.
Natural 20! It burps up a prize. Give 4.

cards.title: Rat Dice
