outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snake eyes. Drink 6.
Snake eyes. Drink 3.
Hot dice. Give 2.
Natural 20! Hot dice. Give 4.

cards.title: Roll Call
cards.rules: Everyone says the dumbest thing they've done in a cellar. The table picks the worst; they drink 2.

cards.title: Mystery Bottle
cards.rules: A dusty bottle, no label. Everyone guesses what's in it; the drawer's favorite guess gives 2.

cards.title: Spider Check
cards.rules: Everyone checks their hair for spiders, loudly. The last to finish drinks 1.

cards.title: Dry Storage
cards.rules: You find a crate of crackers. Everyone eats one or drinks 1.

elite.title: Grease Trap Horror
elite.rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8, then wash your hands in shame.
It slurps you in. Drink 4, then wash your hands in shame.
You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 4.
Natural 20! You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 8.

elite.title: The Health Inspector
elite.rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8 and name three things wrong with this room.
Violation. Drink 4 and name three things wrong with this room.
You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

elite.title: Keg Mimic Queen
elite.rules: Every keg in the rack opens one eye. The big one in the middle opens two. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole rack bites. Drink 8.
The whole rack bites. Drink 4.
You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

spoils.name: Queen's Tap
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

spoils.name: Royal Jelly Shot
spoils.rules: +1 to monster d20s. Comes with a Healing Draught.

elite.title: The Exterminator
elite.rules: He's here for the rats, and he's decided you count. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sprayed. Drink 8, holding your breath.
Sprayed. Drink 4, holding your breath.
You hide him in an empty keg. Give 4.
Natural 20! You hide him in an empty keg. Give 8.

rule.name: Rat Run
rule.rule: When a card mentions a rat, everyone squeaks. Last to squeak drinks 1.

cards.title: Keg Golem
cards.rules: It's 800 pounds of lager and it's been tapped. Everyone drinks 1, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8.
It sits on you. Drink 4.
You pull its plug. Give 5.
Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Keg Plug
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Comes with a Coaster Shield.

phases.rules: It gets back up, foaming. Chug race with your left neighbor, playing the Golem. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: The Rat King
cards.rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court by the drain. Kiss the ring, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink.
The court finds you guilty. Drink 4.
You dethrone him. Give 5.
Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

jinx.name: Royal Decree
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player Your Majesty. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: The court is in session. Plead your case to the table for 20 seconds; they vote. Guilty: drink 3.

cards.title: The Landlord
cards.rules: He wants three months' rent and he's taking it out of your drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink.
Late fee. Drink 4.
You find a code violation. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

phases.rules: He's back with a clipboard for the inspection. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He finds the mold. Drink 4.
He finds nothing. Give 4.

dice.doubles: You find his own code violation. Give 6.

jinx.name: Rent Due
jinx.rule: The jinxed player asks the table's permission before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Big Cheese
cards.rules: A rat the size of a fridge, wearing a cheese wheel as armor. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It sits on your snacks. Drink 8.
It sits on your snacks. Drink 4.
You eat through the armor. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the armor and the rat. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It rolls at you, cheese first. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Flattened. Drink 4.
Cheese in your hair. Drink 3.
You dodge. Give 3.
You take a bite out of it. Give 3.
It rolls into the wall. Give 4.
You grate it. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Pipe Organ
cards.rules: Every pipe in the cellar is playing one chord, and it's coming from a face. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join the chord. Hum for 10 seconds, then drink 8.
The chord hits you in the teeth. Drink 4.
You find the off switch. Give 5.
Natural 20! You find the off switch. Give 10.

spoils.name: Pipe Whistle
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

phases.rules: It plays your song. Hum any song; the table has 15 seconds to name it. Nobody does: drink 3.

jinx.name: Organ Voice
jinx.rule: The jinxed player sings everything they say. Speaks normally: drink 1.

rule.name: Rat Run
rule.rule: When a card mentions a rat, everyone squeaks. Last to squeak drinks 1.

cards.title: The Stairwell
cards.rules: A cold stairwell and one flickering bulb. Everyone stretches. Level up, or sit down.

cards.title: The Smoking Area
cards.rules: Fresh air, a dead heater, somebody's vape. Everyone names their best moment so far.

cards.title: The Coat Check
cards.rules: An empty coat check. Everyone names the coat they'd steal. Level up, or nap on the pile.

cards.title: The Bathroom Line
cards.rules: Twelve deep, and everyone's best friends now. Everyone hypes their left neighbor.

cards.title: The Loading Dock
cards.rules: Pallets, a puddle, one working vending machine. Everyone names the snack they'd get.

cards.title: The Phone Booth
cards.rules: An old phone booth, and the phone works. Everyone says who they'd call right now.

cards.title: The Mop Closet
cards.rules: Mops, buckets, one comfy bucket. Everyone gives their left neighbor a wrestling name.

cards.title: The Photo Booth
cards.rules: A broken photo booth that still flashes. Everyone pulls their best face on three.

cards.title: The Peephole
cards.rules: A slot opens. Invent a password in 5 seconds and sell it. Table says no: drink 3.

cards.title: Flapper Fran
cards.rules: Fran challenges you to a Charleston. Do 5 seconds of it, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Two left feet. Drink 6.
Two left feet. Drink 3.
The room applauds. Pick a dance partner; they drink 3.
Natural 20! The room applauds. Pick a dance partner; they drink 6.

cards.title: Bathtub Gin
cards.rules: A bathtub full of homemade gin, and a ladle. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It tastes like a radiator. Drink 3.
You go blind for a minute. Drink 3.
Smooth, somehow. Give 2.
You ladle out a round. Give 3.
You find the still's off switch. Give 3.
You bottle it and sell it. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: The Proprietor
cards.rules: A bootlegger, dead since Prohibition, still running the room. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 8.
He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 4.
You tip off the feds. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the place. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Prohibition
jinx.rule: Nobody says the word 'drink'. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: The Password
spoils.rules: +2 to elite d20s. +1 to ambush d20s.

phases.rules: He wants the password. Make one up and say it like you mean it; the table votes. No: drink 4.

cards.title: Freezer Burn
cards.rules: A steak that's been in here since 2009 and has become sentient and bitter. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tastes like the freezer. Drink 8.
It tastes like the freezer. Drink 4.
You thaw it. It apologizes. Give 4.
Natural 20! You thaw it. It apologizes. Give 8.

jinx.name: Brain Freeze
jinx.rule: The jinxed player clutches their head and says 'brain freeze' after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Ice Wraith
cards.rules: A ghost made of frost, breathing on the back of your neck. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Chills, the bad kind. Drink 8.
Chills, the bad kind. Drink 4.
You breathe back, harder. Breathe on someone's neck; they drink 4.
Natural 20! It melts into a puddle. Give 8.

cards.title: The Frozen Bachelor
cards.rules: A groom-to-be, frozen mid-shot at his bachelor party. He's thawing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He finishes the shot on you. Drink 8.
He finishes the shot on you. Drink 4.
You get him to the church. Pick a best man; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You get him to the church. Pick a best man; they drink 8.

cards.title: Frost Giant Bartender
cards.rules: Nine feet tall, ice for hands, and he says you're cut off. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He pours you a glacier. Drink 8.
He pours you a glacier. Drink 4.
You tip him. He warms right up. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tip him. He warms right up. Give 8.

cards.title: Brain Freeze
cards.rules: It's not a monster. It's the pain behind your eyes, and it's winning.

strike.advantage: You think warm thoughts. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Full freeze. Drink 4, holding your forehead.

cards.title: The Snowman
cards.rules: Carrot nose, coal eyes, and a grudge from every winter you built one.

strike.advantage: You take his carrot. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: A snowball to the face. Drink 4.

cards.title: The Ice Sculpture
cards.rules: A swan carved in ice, from a wedding nobody came back from. It moves. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It pecks. Drink 8.
It pecks. Drink 4.
You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 8.

jinx.name: Frozen
jinx.rule: Whenever the jinxed player says 'freeze', the last to stop moving drinks 1.

cards.title: The Mammoth
cards.rules: Thawed out of the ice cream tubs and furious about the last ten thousand years. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Trampled. Drink 8.
Trampled. Drink 4.
You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show it a mammoth on your phone. It cries. Give 8.

cards.title: Hypothermia Hal
cards.rules: Hal is fine. Hal is great, actually. Hal has taken his shirt off. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 8.
Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 4.
You get Hal a coat. Give 4 to the least-dressed player here.
Natural 20! You get Hal a coat. Give 8 to the least-dressed player here.

jinx.name: Chattering Teeth
jinx.rule: The jinxed player chatters their teeth before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Margarita Elemental
cards.rules: A slushie with salt on its rim and nothing to lose. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It brain-freezes you. Drink 8.
It brain-freezes you. Drink 4.
You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 3.
Natural 20! You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 6.

cards.title: The Shiver
cards.rules: Say the coldest thing you've ever said to an ex, true or not. Nobody winces: drink 4.

cards.title: Frozen Solid
cards.rules: Strike your coldest pose and hold it, dead still, for 15 seconds. Move: drink 4.

cards.title: The Icebreaker
cards.rules: Deliver your best icebreaker to your left neighbor. The table groans: drink 4.

cards.title: The Cold Open
cards.rules: Name a cold drink for every letter of COLD in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Slippery Floor
cards.rules: Black ice, right where the door used to be. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flat on your back. Drink 6.
Flat on your back. Drink 3.
You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 3.
Natural 20! You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 6.

cards.title: The Door Shuts
cards.rules: Click. The handle's on the outside.

strike.advantage: You find the safety knob. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: You're in here now. Drink 3.

cards.title: Icicle Drop
cards.rules: The ceiling is all icicles, and you just sneezed. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One finds you. Drink 6.
One finds you. Drink 3.
You step aside. It shatters. Give 3.
Natural 20! You step aside. It shatters. Give 6.

cards.title: Tongue on the Pole
cards.rules: A metal shelf, a dare, and you've already done it.

strike.advantage: You breathe it free. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Stuck. Drink 3, and talk like it for one sentence.

cards.title: The Penguin Gang
cards.rules: Six penguins in matching tuxes, and they say you're on their ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 6.
Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 3.
You out-waddle them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-waddle them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Frozen Peas
cards.rules: A bag split open and now there are peas everywhere, and they're organized. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Peas down your shirt. Drink 6.
Peas down your shirt. Drink 3.
You ice your knee with them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You ice your knee with them. Give 6.

cards.title: Popsicle Golem
cards.rules: A golem of a thousand stuck-together popsicles, in every flavor you hate.

strike.advantage: You sweet-talk it into melting. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Banana. Drink 4.

cards.title: The Thawed Caveman
cards.rules: A caveman thawed out and wants to know what a phone is. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He clubs your phone. Drink 4.
You show him a meme. Grunt at someone; they drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you chief. Everyone else grunts and drinks 4.

cards.title: Ice Goblin
cards.rules: A goblin juggling ice cubes, and aiming them down your back.

strike.advantage: You juggle better. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Down your shirt. Drink 4.

cards.title: Chattering Teeth
cards.rules: Say 'she sells seashells' three times through chattering teeth. Fumble it: drink 4.

cards.title: The Ice Machine
cards.rules: The ice machine is jammed and shaking. Roll d20 before it blows.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 6.
Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 3.
You unplug it in time. Give 3, ice cold.
Natural 20! You unplug it in time. Give 6, ice cold.

cards.title: Ski Lodge Crew
cards.rules: Five people in ski gear who never made it to the slopes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They make you join their shot ski. Drink 6.
They make you join their shot ski. Drink 3.
You send them to the hot tub. Give 3.
Natural 20! You send them to the hot tub. Give 6.

cards.title: Ice Bucket Challenge
cards.rules: A bucket of ice water on a rope. Pull, then cash out or pull again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole bucket. Drink 8.
The whole bucket. Drink 4.
Just a splash. Give 3.
Natural 20! Just a splash. Give 6.

cards.title: Frozen in the Ice
cards.rules: A bottle frozen in a block of ice, or a hand holding one. Chip it out, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's a hand. Drink 8.
It's a hand. Drink 4.
Something old and good. Give 4 to the oldest player here.
Natural 20! Something old and good. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

cards.title: The Chest Freezer
cards.rules: A padlocked chest freezer, scratched on the inside of the lid. Open it, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something climbs out. Drink 8.
Something climbs out. Drink 4.
Ice cream and a loaded die. Give 4 to whoever wants a scoop.
Natural 20! Ice cream and a loaded die. Give 8 to whoever wants a scoop.

jinx.name: Frozen Solid
jinx.rule: The jinxed player keeps one hand on their head. Lets go: drink 1.

cards.title: The Lost Parka
cards.rules: A parka on a hook, a hip flask in the pocket. Drink 1, and keep the flask.

cards.title: The Ice Tray
cards.rules: An ice tray, every cube frozen around a coin. One of them is a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

cards.title: The Compressor
cards.rules: Warm air blowing out of a vent. Everyone huddles in and sips.

cards.title: Hot Chocolate
cards.rules: A thermos of hot chocolate, still warm, with a note: FOR WHOEVER'S NEXT. Everyone sips, slowly.

cards.title: The Yeti
cards.rules: A yeti in a cardigan runs a little shop out of the ice cream aisle.

cards.title: The Frozen Mime
cards.rules: A mime who got stuck in here mid-act. He sells by pointing.

cards.title: Two Shelves
cards.rules: Behind the frozen peas, or through the ice cream aisle, where something licks.

cards.title: The Meat Hooks
cards.rules: Duck under the empty hooks, or push through the full ones, swinging on their own.

cards.title: Ice Fishing
cards.rules: A hole in the ice, a line in it. Cash out or cast again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You fall in. Drink 8.
You fall in. Drink 4.
A bite. Give 3.
Natural 20! A bite. Give 6.

cards.title: Mimic Fridge
cards.rules: A mini fridge with a heartbeat. It pays out until it bites. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8.
It bites. Drink 4.
A cold one. Give 3.
Natural 20! A cold one. Give 6.

cards.title: The Snow Globe
cards.rules: Shake the giant snow globe. Win, then cash out or shake again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cracks. Drink 8.
It cracks. Drink 4.
Something floats up. Give 3.
Natural 20! Something floats up. Give 6.

cards.title: Penguin Walk
cards.rules: The drawer waddles like a penguin to the nearest wall and back. Refuse: drink 3.

cards.title: Cold Take
cards.rules: Everyone shares their coldest take. The table picks the coldest; they give 3.

cards.title: Huddle Up
cards.rules: Everyone huddles in for warmth. Anyone who won't drinks 2.

cards.title: Hot Cocoa
cards.rules: Everyone warms their hands on their drink and takes a slow, cozy sip.

elite.title: The Ice Queen
elite.rules: She rules the freezer, and she has never once let anything go. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She freezes you out. Drink 10.
She freezes you out. Drink 5.
You sing at her. She thaws. Give 5.
Natural 20! You sing at her. She thaws. Give 10.

elite.title: The Abominable Barback
elite.rules: Eight feet of white fur and an ice scoop, and you just asked for no ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 10.
He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 5.
You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 10.

elite.title: The Enforcer
elite.rules: The mob keeps him in here for people who owe. You don't. He doesn't care. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He puts you on ice. Drink 10.
He puts you on ice. Drink 5.
You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 10.

elite.title: The Freezer Witch
elite.rules: She keeps her ex in a block of ice, and there's room for one more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're on ice. Drink 10.
You're on ice. Drink 5.
You thaw the ex. Give 5 to whoever has an ex on ice.
Natural 20! You thaw the ex. Give 10 to whoever has an ex on ice.

rule.name: Frostbite
rule.rule: Hold your drink in your off hand. Caught with the other: drink 1.

cards.title: The Walk-in
cards.rules: The freezer itself wakes up, and the door shuts, and the light goes out. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drops ten degrees. Drink 10.
It drops ten degrees. Drink 5.
You unplug it at the wall. Give 5.
Natural 20! You kick the door off. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The light's out. Eyes shut, touch the nose of your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Snow Bartender
cards.rules: He pours with snow and he serves only frozen drinks, and he never stops. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You order a slushie. Finish your drink.
Frozen daiquiri, straight to the brain. Drink 5.
You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 10.

spoils.name: Frost Shaker
spoils.rules: Comes with a Healing Draught and a Bar Tab.

phases.rules: He serves the brain freeze. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Brain freeze. Drink 5.
You drink it slowly, like an adult. Give 5.

dice.doubles: You hand it back. He freezes solid. Give 7.

jinx.name: Brrr
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'brrr'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Absolute Zero
cards.rules: The coldest thing there is. It doesn't move. Nothing near it does either. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You stop moving. Drink 10.
You stop moving. Drink 5.
You rub your hands together. It's enough. Give 5.
Natural 20! You light a match. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Chattering
jinx.rule: The jinxed player's teeth chatter whenever they speak. Forget: drink 1.

phases.rules: Freeze while the table counts to 15. Move, laugh or blink: drink 4.

cards.title: The Ice Cream Man
cards.rules: His van's in here somehow, and the music is playing in a minor key. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You get in the van. Finish your drink.
Rocky road. Drink 5.
You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 5.
Natural 20! You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 10.

phases.rules: He plays the jingle. Name six ice cream flavors in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

cards.title: The Frozen Ex
cards.rules: Your ex, frozen at the exact moment you broke up, now thawing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 10.
They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 5.
You say you've moved on, and mean it. They shatter. Give 5.
Natural 20! You both laugh about it. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Closure
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: They want closure. Say three nice things about an ex in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: As I Was Saying
jinx.rule: The jinxed player starts every sentence with 'As I was saying'. Forgets: drink 1.

rule.name: Frostbite
rule.rule: Hold your drink in your off hand. Caught with the other: drink 1.

cards.title: The Boiler Room
cards.rules: Warm pipes and somebody's cot. Everyone warms their hands. Level up, or lie down.

cards.title: A Campfire
cards.rules: Someone lit a fire in a keg. Everyone tells the scariest thing that's happened tonight.

cards.title: The Staff Room
cards.rules: A kettle and a sign: WASH YOUR OWN MUG. Everyone mimes washing one.

cards.title: The Fire Escape
cards.rules: Stars, a city, and the street far below. Everyone toasts how far you've come.

cards.title: The Service Stairs
cards.rules: Halfway down, a step wide enough to sit on. Everyone says what they'd order right now.

cards.title: The Bunker
cards.rules: An old bomb shelter with canned beans. Everyone names who they'd want down here.

cards.title: The Laundry Room
cards.rules: Warm dryers humming. Everyone confesses their worst laundry crime.

cards.title: The Stuck Elevator
cards.rules: An elevator stuck between floors, the music still playing. Everyone hums along on three.

cards.title: Chad's Shortcut
cards.rules: Chad found a service elevator and is holding the door shut on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins. Take the stairs and drink 8.
He wins. Take the stairs and drink 4.
You squeeze in. Give 4.
Natural 20! You squeeze in. Give 8.

cards.title: Brad's Group Photo
cards.rules: Brad stops the whole staircase for a group photo, and you're in the way. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You're cropped out. Drink 4.
You photobomb it. Everyone poses; the worst pose drinks 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! It's your photo now. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Thad's Pep Talk
cards.rules: Thad pep-talks the boys. Give your table a better one in 10 seconds. Worse: drink 4.

cards.title: Brad's Leaderboard
cards.rules: Brad keeps a leaderboard of who's had the most tonight, and you're second. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He pulls ahead. Drink 8.
He pulls ahead. Drink 4.
You overtake him. Give 4 to whoever's last.
Natural 20! You lap him twice. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Recruitment
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips want you in. Thad is holding out a quarter-zip. Roll d20 to say no.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You say yes. Drink 8.
You say yes. Drink 4.
You say no and mean it. Make someone zip up; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You say no and mean it. Make someone zip up; they drink 8.

jinx.name: One of the Boys
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'bro'. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Deep Fryer Demon
cards.rules: It'll fry anything. It's looking at your hand.

strike.advantage: You freeze the oil with a spell. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: Battered. Drink 5.

cards.title: Line Cook Golem
cards.rules: Seven feet of burns and tattoos, ten tickets deep, and you're in the way. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Behind! Drink 10.
Behind! Drink 5.
You run his food. He respects you. Give 5.
Natural 20! You run his food. He respects you. Give 10.

jinx.name: Behind!
jinx.rule: The jinxed player yells 'Behind!' whenever they stand up. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Sentient Sourdough
cards.rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10.
It rises over you. Drink 5.
You punch it down. Give 5 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.
Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.

cards.title: Garlic Breath Wraith
cards.rules: A wraith that only ever exhales. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You'll taste it for a week. Drink 8.
You'll taste it for a week. Drink 4.
You hold your breath. Breathe on someone; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Breathe on someone; they drink 10.

jinx.name: Garlic Breath
jinx.rule: The jinxed player covers their mouth to talk. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Expo
cards.rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Plates everywhere. Drink 5.
You drop table six's steak. Drink 5.
You burn your palm on a plate. Drink 5.
Order up. Give 4.
Order up, hot and fast. Give 5.
You run six plates at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Food Critic Ghoul
cards.rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
One star. Drink 5, and give the room a one-star review out loud.
You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 4.
Natural 20! You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 8.

cards.title: Cold Room Yeti
cards.rules: Something lives in the cold room, and it ate all the shrimp.

strike.advantage: You lock it in. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: Cold hug. Drink 5.

cards.title: Dish Pit Horror
cards.rules: Something under the dish pit water has been eating forks.

strike.even: It burps up a fork. Drink 3.
strike.advantage: You bless the water and it sinks. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: It eats your fork. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Screaming Chef
cards.rules: A ghost chef who calls everything raw. It's not even food. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 10.
You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 5.
You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5.
Natural 20! You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10.

jinx.name: Idiot Sandwich
jinx.rule: The jinxed player answers to 'idiot sandwich' only. Answer to their name: drink 1.

cards.title: Rogue Rotisserie
cards.rules: Twelve chickens on a spit, turning, and turning toward you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Basted. Drink 5.
You carve your way out. Carve someone a drumstick; they drink 5.

dice.doubles: Chicken for everyone. Everyone else drinks 5 with a mouthful.

cards.title: Yes, Chef
cards.rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Four Plates
cards.rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

cards.title: The Hot Sauce Wall
cards.rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Pitch
cards.rules: Pitch the table a new dish in 20 seconds. Fewer than half would eat it: drink 5.

cards.title: Grease Fire
cards.rules: Somebody threw water on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8.
Singed. Drink 4.
You smother it with a lid. Give 3 to whoever looks hot.
Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6 to whoever looks hot.

cards.title: Wet Floor
cards.rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds.
You skate it. Give 3.
Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

cards.title: The Swinging Door
cards.rules: One door, in and out, and a server is coming through with a full tray.

strike.advantage: You spin past. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: Tray to the face. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Mandoline
cards.rules: The guard is off the mandoline and it's slicing on its own. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Thinly sliced. Drink 8.
Thinly sliced. Drink 4.
You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 3.
Natural 20! You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 6.

cards.title: Raccoon Crew
cards.rules: Two raccoons in chef's hats are stealing the bread. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take your fries too. Drink 8.
They take your fries too. Drink 4.
You chase them out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Brunch Crowd
cards.rules: It's 2 a.m. and a brunch crowd has arrived demanding bottomless mimosas. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bottomless. Drink 8.
Bottomless. Drink 4.
You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 8.

cards.title: Microwave Ghost
cards.rules: The ghost of every fish ever microwaved in the break room. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You smell like it now. Drink 10.
You smell like it now. Drink 5.
You open a window. Give 5 to whoever brought fish to work.
Natural 20! You open a window. Give 10 to whoever brought fish to work.

cards.title: The Rat Chef
cards.rules: A rat under a chef's hat is steering the line cook. He wants your order.

strike.advantage: You compliment the chef. Give 5.
strike.disadvantage: He serves you. Drink 5.

cards.title: The Ticket Machine
cards.rules: The ticket printer won't stop. Two hundred orders, all for you. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You're in the weeds. Drink 5.
Heard. Shout 'Heard!' and give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You 86 everything. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Order
cards.rules: Repeat back every drink at the table, in order, from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: The Hot Pan
cards.rules: Somebody left a pan on the burner, and the handle's glowing.

strike.advantage: You grab a towel like a pro. Give 4.
strike.disadvantage: You grab it. Drink 5, then blow on your hand.

cards.title: The Food Truck Guys
cards.rules: Two food truck guys broke in to rob your walk-in. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They sell you your own food. Drink 8.
They sell you your own food. Drink 4.
You chase them off with a ladle. Give 4.
Natural 20! You chase them off with a ladle. Give 8.

cards.title: Hot Sauce Ladder
cards.rules: Each rung is a hotter sauce. Win, then cash out or climb again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Your mouth is on fire. Drink 10.
Your mouth is on fire. Drink 5.
You don't blink once. Give 4.
Natural 20! You don't blink once. Give 8.

cards.title: The Back Burner
cards.rules: A pot that's been simmering since opening night. Taste it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fish heads. Drink 10.
Fish heads. Drink 5.
Best soup of your life. Give 5 to whoever cooks the worst.
Natural 20! Best soup of your life. Give 10 to whoever cooks the worst.

cards.title: The Mystery Meat
cards.rules: A covered tray marked DO NOT SERVE. It's warm. Lift the lid, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lifts the lid back. Drink 10.
It lifts the lid back. Drink 5.
Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 5.
Natural 20! Brisket. Perfect brisket. Give 10.

jinx.name: The Meat
jinx.rule: The jinxed player calls every drink 'the meat'. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Staff Meal
cards.rules: Fries, pickles, and a shot the cooks hid for you. Drink 1, and pocket a smoke bomb.

cards.title: Knife Roll
cards.rules: A chef's knife roll left on the pass, something heavy in the end pocket. Drink 1.

cards.title: The Break Room
cards.rules: A couch, a microwave, and twelve minutes of peace. Everyone sits down and sips.

cards.title: Family Meal
cards.rules: The cooks sit down to eat, and they set a place for you. Everyone toasts the cooks.

cards.title: The Dishwasher
cards.rules: The dishwasher has seen everything, and he'll sell you some of it, for drinks or blood.

cards.title: The Sous Chef
cards.rules: The sous chef is selling the head chef's stash, quietly, out the back.

cards.title: The Pass
cards.rules: Two ways out: the quiet back door, or straight through the line in the dinner rush.

cards.title: The Dumbwaiter
cards.rules: The fire stairs, or the dumbwaiter, which is shaking and going down on its own.

cards.title: The Mystery Box
cards.rules: A chef's mystery box. Win, then cash out or open another, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Durian. Drink 10.
Durian. Drink 5.
Truffles. Give 4.
Natural 20! Truffles. Give 8.

cards.title: Mimic Oven
cards.rules: An oven that bakes treats until it bites. Cash out or open it again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 10.
It bites. Drink 5.
Fresh out of the oven. Give 4.
Natural 20! Fresh out of the oven. Give 8.

cards.title: The Pancake Flip
cards.rules: The line cooks bet on your flips. Win, then cash out or flip again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's on the ceiling. Drink 10.
It's on the ceiling. Drink 5.
Golden. Give 4.
Natural 20! Golden. Give 8.

cards.title: Yes, Chef
cards.rules: The drawer is chef until their next turn. Anyone who doesn't answer them with 'Yes, chef' drinks 1.

cards.title: Last Meal
cards.rules: Everyone names their last meal on earth. The table picks the weirdest; they drink 2.

cards.title: Order Up
cards.rules: The drawer shouts an order; everyone repeats it back. Anyone who gets it wrong drinks 2.

cards.title: Staff Meal
cards.rules: Everyone takes a bite of something, or a sip, and thanks the kitchen.

elite.title: The Head Chef
elite.rules: He's thrown a pan at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The pan. Drink 12.
The pan. Drink 6.
You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 6.
Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 12.

elite.title: The Butcher
elite.rules: The butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Filleted. Drink 12.
Filleted. Drink 6.
You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6.
Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

elite.title: The Owner
elite.rules: He's back from his third divorce and he's doing the books tonight. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He blames you for the books. Drink 12.
He blames you for the books. Drink 6.
You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 6.
Natural 20! You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 12.

spoils.name: Partner's Keyring
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with 2 Healing Draughts.

spoils.name: Owner's Comp Card
spoils.rules: +1 to ambush d20s. Every heal heals 1 more.

elite.title: The Celebrity Chef
elite.rules: He has a TV show, a catchphrase and a temper, and you're on. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 12.
He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 6.
You make his dish better. Call someone a donkey; they drink 6.
Natural 20! You make his dish better. Call someone a donkey; they drink 12.

spoils.name: Chef's Knife
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, elite and ambush d20s.

rule.name: Health Inspection
rule.rule: Anyone who touches their face drinks 1. The table watches.

cards.title: The Last Table
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips want your table. Brad is already sitting on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Brad sits on you. Drink 8.
Brad sits on you. Drink 4.
You tip the table, gently. Give 4.
Natural 20! You tip Brad off it. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: Brad's still on it. On go, race Brad (your left neighbor) to sit on it. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: A Toast to the Boys
cards.rules: Thad is giving a toast about 'the boys', eleven minutes in. Roll d20 to cut him off.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You cry at it. Finish your drink.
It's moving, somehow. Raise a glass and drink 4.
You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 4.
Natural 20! You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 8.

phases.rules: Your turn: toast the Quarter-Zips, sincerely, for ten seconds. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: Chad's Last Round
cards.rules: Chad ordered the last round, for the boys only. Intercept it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 8.
He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 4.
You carry the tray to your own table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You carry the tray, and Chad tips you. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: For the Boys
jinx.rule: The jinxed player says 'for the boys' before every drink. Forget: drink 1.

phases.rules: Chad grabs the tray back. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He spills it on you. Drink 4.
It's yours. Give 4.

cards.title: Brad's Venmo Request
cards.rules: Brad has Venmo-requested everyone here $14.50 for 'vibes'. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You accidentally pay it. Drink 8.
You accidentally pay it. Drink 4.
You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 4.
Natural 20! You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 8.

phases.rules: Pay Brad (your left neighbor) back in compliments: three in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: Request Sent
jinx.rule: The jinxed player says 'I'll Venmo you' when given a drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Dance-Off
cards.rules: The Quarter-Zips call a dance-off. The whole bar is watching. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Brad does the worm. You can't follow that. Drink 4.
You pull something. Drink 4.
Thad dips you. You let him. Drink 4.
You do the robot, and mean it. Give 4.
You moonwalk out the door and back. Give 4.
Everyone in the bar joins your dance. Everyone else drinks 2.

phases.rules: Round two: you and Thad (your left neighbor) dance, no music. The table votes. Thad wins: drink 4.

cards.title: The Boys' Tab
cards.rules: Brad closes his tab and puts it on yours. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Signed. Drink 8.
Signed. Drink 4.
You sign it 'Brad'. Give 4.
Natural 20! You sign it 'Brad'. Give 8.

phases.rules: The bartender wants a signature. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You sign it. Drink 4.
You sign it twice. Drink 4.
You tip 30% on it. Drink 3.
You sign it 'Brad'. Give 3.
You sign it 'Chad'. Give 4.
You sign it 'The Boys'. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Thad's Uber
cards.rules: Thad ordered one ride for everyone, and it's a Prius. Roll 2d6 for a seat.

outcomes.instruction: You're in the trunk. Drink 4.
Front seat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! Thad's in the trunk. Everyone else drinks 2.

phases.rules: Shotgun: you and Thad (your left neighbor) call it. The table says who was first. Thad: drink 4.

cards.title: The Rematch
cards.rules: Chad wants a rematch for the queue. He's been stretching since the door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's been training. Drink 8.
He's been training. Drink 4.
Same result as the door. Give 4.
Natural 20! Chad is so impressed he buys your table a round. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: Thumb war with Chad (your left neighbor), best of three. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: The Last Call Lich
cards.rules: A bony hand rings the bell. It's last call forever unless you kill it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Closing time. Everyone drinks 8.
Closing time. Everyone drinks 4.
It flickers. Give 5.
Natural 20! The music comes back on. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: It rings the bell. Out-shout your left neighbor: 'One more!' The table judges. Lose: drink 4.
One bony hand left on the bell. Everyone raises a glass. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The bell rings. Everyone drinks 8.
The bell rings. Everyone drinks 4.
You take the bell. Everyone else drinks 4.
Natural 20! You take the bell. Everyone else drinks 8.

cards.title: The Bartender Below
cards.rules: It knows your usual. It knows what you did. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cuts you off. Drink 12.
It cuts you off. Drink 6.
You tip it. It staggers. Give 5.
Natural 20! You rob the tip jar. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: It wants your order in three seconds, with a straight face. The table judges. Fail: drink 4.
It reaches for the cut-off bell. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Cut off. Finish your drink, then a fresh one.
Cut off. Finish your drink.
You tip big. It weeps. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tip big. It weeps. Give 10.

cards.title: The Final Tab
cards.rules: Every drink you've ever ordered, itemized, four feet long, and it has teeth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Itemized. Drink 10.
Itemized. Drink 5.
You dispute a charge. Give 5.
Natural 20! Comped. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Split the bill: say what everyone at the table drank tonight, in ten seconds. Miss one: drink 4.
The total comes in. It's a lot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You pay. Everyone drinks 8.
You pay. Everyone drinks 4.
You dine and dash. Give 6.
Natural 20! You dine and dash. Give 12.

cards.title: The House Lights
cards.rules: The lights come up, and everyone looks like that. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You saw yourself. Drink 12.
You saw yourself. Drink 6.
You smash a bulb. Give 5.
Natural 20! Darkness again. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Everyone looks at you. Strike a pose and hold it while the table counts to ten. Break: drink 4.
The last bulb flickers. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Full brightness. Everyone drinks 8.
Full brightness. Everyone drinks 4.
Darkness. Everyone else drinks 4.
Natural 20! Darkness. Everyone else drinks 8.

jinx.name: Lit Up
jinx.rule: The jinxed player squints at everyone. Caught with their eyes wide open: drink 1.

cards.title: The 2 a.m. Kebab
cards.rules: It's been turning since 8 p.m. It knew you'd come. It's the size of a door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drop it on the floor and eat it anyway. Drink 10.
Garlic sauce, everywhere. Drink 5.
You carve it down to the spit. Give 5.
Natural 20! You eat the whole thing, standing. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Order for the table in one breath: what everyone wants on theirs. Stumble: drink 4.
It's down to the spit, and it's still turning. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Garlic sauce in your eye. Drink 10.
Garlic sauce in your eye. Drink 5.
You eat the last bite. Give 6.
Natural 20! You eat the last bite. Give 12.

cards.title: Surge Pricing
cards.rules: The ride home costs $94 and it's sentient. It's circling the block, laughing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Surge goes up again. Drink 10.
Surge goes up again. Drink 5.
You find a driver who's going your way. Give 5.
Natural 20! Free ride. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Haggle a fare with your left neighbor, playing the driver, for ten seconds. They refuse: drink 4.
It's three minutes away, forever. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Ride cancelled. Everyone drinks 8.
Ride cancelled. Everyone drinks 4.
Five stars. Give 6.
Natural 20! Five stars. Give 12.

jinx.name: Surge
jinx.rule: The jinxed player adds 'plus tax' to every drink they're given. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Group Chat
cards.rules: Tomorrow's group chat, awake early, reading tonight back to you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Someone posts the video. Drink 12.
Someone posts the video. Drink 6.
You leave the chat. It can't follow. Give 5.
Natural 20! You mute it forever. Everyone else drinks 4.

jinx.name: Muted
jinx.rule: The jinxed player can only mime. Say a word: drink 1.

phases.rules: Read your last sent text out loud to the table. Refuse: drink 4.
Someone's typing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's the video. Everyone drinks 8.
It's the video. Everyone drinks 4.
It's a meme. You're safe. Give 6.
Natural 20! It's a meme. You're safe. Give 12.

cards.title: The Morning After
cards.rules: Your hangover from tomorrow came back in time to stop you. It's enormous. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands a preview. Drink 10 and a glass of water.
It lands a preview. Drink 5 and a glass of water.
You promise it a greasy breakfast. It backs off. Give 5.
Natural 20! You were never going to have a hangover. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Drink a full glass of water without stopping. Stop: drink 4.
It rises with the sun. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sunrise. Everyone drinks 8.
Sunrise. Everyone drinks 4.
Blackout curtains. Give 6.
Natural 20! Blackout curtains. Give 12.
